en: The doctor said the abnormal results of my blood test were probably caused by lack of sleep.
zh: 醫生說我驗血結果不正常，可能是睡眠不足造成的。

en: Many schools in Taiwan have decided to abolish the old rule that students must wear uniforms every day.
zh: 台灣許多學校已決定廢除學生每天都必須穿制服的舊規定。

en: In health class, we read a news report about how different countries make laws on abortion.
zh: 在健康課上，我們讀了一篇關於不同國家如何制定墮胎相關法律的新聞報導。

en: The bus came to an abrupt stop when a dog suddenly ran across the road.
zh: 一隻狗突然衝過馬路，公車猛然停了下來。

en: It seems absurd to wear a heavy winter coat on such a hot summer day.
zh: 在這麼炎熱的夏天穿厚重的冬季大衣，似乎很荒謬。

en: Thanks to abundant rain this spring, the farmers expect a large rice harvest in June.
zh: 多虧今年春天雨量豐沛，農夫們預期六月稻米會大豐收。

en: Experts warn that the abuse of pain medicine can cause serious damage to the liver.
zh: 專家警告，濫用止痛藥可能對肝臟造成嚴重傷害。

en: Regular exercise can help accelerate your recovery after a long and serious illness.
zh: 規律運動有助於加速你在久病之後的復原。

en: The new library is easily accessible by bus, so many students study there after school.
zh: 新圖書館搭公車就能輕鬆到達，所以很多學生放學後去那裡讀書。

en: Our school hall can accommodate about eight hundred people, so the whole grade can attend the concert.
zh: 我們學校的禮堂可以容納大約八百人，所以全年級都能參加音樂會。

en: During the school trip to Hualien, our accommodation was a small hotel near the beach.
zh: 去花蓮校外教學期間，我們住宿的地方是海邊附近的一家小旅館。

en: After a long discussion, the two classes finally reached an accord on how to share the gym.
zh: 經過長時間討論，兩個班級終於就如何共用體育館達成協議。

en: My older sister studies accounting in college because she is good with numbers.
zh: 我姊姊在大學念會計，因為她很擅長處理數字。

en: Ben finally acknowledged that he had made a mistake and said sorry to the rest of the team.
zh: Ben 終於承認自己犯了錯，並向其他隊員道歉。

en: On the first day of school, the teacher played games to help us get acquainted with one another.
zh: 開學第一天，老師帶我們玩遊戲，幫助我們彼此認識。

en: Many studies show that language acquisition is often faster for young children than for adults.
zh: 許多研究顯示，幼童習得語言通常比成人快。

en: A young environmental activist gave a speech at our school about reducing plastic waste.
zh: 一位年輕的環保人士來我們學校演講，談如何減少塑膠垃圾。

en: Lisa was rushed to the hospital last night because she had acute pain in her stomach.
zh: Lisa 昨晚因為胃部急性疼痛被緊急送醫。

en: Yesterday the school administration announced that the library will stay open until nine during exam week.
zh: 學校行政部門昨天宣布，考試週期間圖書館將開放到晚上九點。

en: Teachers spend a lot of time on administrative work, such as filling out forms and writing reports.
zh: 老師們花很多時間處理行政工作，例如填表格和寫報告。

en: If you cannot log in to the school website, please contact the system administrator for help.
zh: 如果你無法登入學校網站，請聯絡系統管理員協助。

en: Many adolescents feel pressure to look perfect because of the photos they see on social media.
zh: 許多青少年因為在社群媒體上看到的照片，而感到必須看起來完美的壓力。

en: My little sister adores her new puppy and plays with it every day after school.
zh: 我妹妹非常喜愛她的新小狗，每天放學後都跟牠玩。

en: Heavy rain had an adverse effect on the fruit harvest, so prices went up this summer.
zh: 大雨對水果收成造成不利影響，所以今年夏天價格上漲了。

en: Our science teacher is a strong advocate of learning through hands-on experiments in class.
zh: 我們的自然老師大力提倡在課堂上透過動手做實驗來學習。

en: Grandma showed her affection for us by cooking our favorite dishes every weekend.
zh: 奶奶每個週末煮我們最愛吃的菜，來表達她對我們的疼愛。

en: First on the agenda for today's class meeting is a plan for the school sports day.
zh: 今天班會議程的第一項是規劃學校運動會。

en: Studies show that a lack of sleep can increase aggression and make people more easily angry.
zh: 研究顯示，睡眠不足會增加攻擊性，使人更容易生氣。

en: After breaking his leg in the game, the player lay on the field in agony.
zh: 那位球員在比賽中摔斷腿後，痛苦萬分地躺在球場上。

en: Rice and tea are two of the most important agricultural products in central Taiwan.
zh: 稻米和茶是台灣中部最重要的兩種農產品。

en: Please do not leave your bags in the aisle, because other passengers need to walk through.
zh: 請不要把包包放在走道上，因為其他乘客需要通過。

en: Young people under eighteen are not allowed to buy beer or other alcoholic drinks in Taiwan.
zh: 在台灣，未滿十八歲的年輕人不可以購買啤酒或其他含酒精飲料。

en: In the movie, a friendly alien lands on Earth and becomes friends with a lonely girl.
zh: 在這部電影中，一個友善的外星人降落在地球，並和一個孤單的女孩成為朋友。

en: Amy is allergic to peanuts, so she always checks the list of ingredients before eating snacks.
zh: Amy 對花生過敏，所以她吃零食前總會先看成分表。

en: Every spring, my brother's allergy gets worse, and he cannot stop coughing at night.
zh: 每年春天，我哥哥的過敏都會變嚴重，晚上會咳個不停。

en: Several small shops formed an alliance to compete with the large supermarket in town.
zh: 幾家小商店組成聯盟，與鎮上的大型超市競爭。

en: Next year, the city government will allocate more money to building bike lanes.
zh: 市政府明年將分配更多經費來興建自行車道。

en: During the group project, Mia became my closest ally when others did not agree with my idea.
zh: 在小組報告期間，當其他人不同意我的想法時，Mia 成了我最親近的盟友。

en: Students worked alongside farmers in the fields to learn how rice is grown.
zh: 學生們和農夫一起在田裡工作，學習稻米是怎麼種出來的。

en: Climate change may alter the paths that birds take when they fly south for the winter.
zh: 氣候變遷可能會改變鳥類南飛過冬時所走的路線。

en: My brother and I wash the dishes on alternate days, so each of us gets a break.
zh: 我和哥哥隔天輪流洗碗，所以我們每個人都能休息。

en: After hearing the students' opinions, the school decided to amend the rules about phone use.
zh: 聽取學生的意見後，學校決定修改有關手機使用的規定。

en: There is ample time to finish the test, so read each question carefully before answering.
zh: 有充足的時間完成考試，所以作答前請仔細閱讀每一題。

en: A business analyst studies market data to help companies decide what products to sell.
zh: 商業分析師研究市場資料，幫助公司決定要販賣哪些產品。

en: An anonymous person gave a large amount of money to help the children's hospital.
zh: 一位匿名人士捐了一大筆錢幫助兒童醫院。

en: We did not anticipate such a crowd at the night market, so we waited a long time for food.
zh: 我們沒預料到夜市會有這麼多人，所以等食物等了很久。

en: My grandfather collects antique clocks, and some of them are over a hundred years old.
zh: 我爺爺收藏古董時鐘，其中有些已經超過一百年了。

en: When the band finished their last song, the whole hall was filled with loud applause.
zh: 樂團唱完最後一首歌時，整個禮堂響起熱烈的掌聲。

en: To save energy, turn off kitchen appliances such as rice cookers when you are not using them.
zh: 為了節省能源，不用電鍋等廚房家電時，請把電源關掉。

en: Children are apt to copy what they see adults do, so parents should set a good example.
zh: 孩子容易模仿他們看到大人所做的事，所以父母應該以身作則。

en: This architect designed a green building that uses the sun and wind to save energy.
zh: 這位建築師設計了一棟利用陽光和風來節能的綠建築。

en: Many tourists visit Tainan to admire its old temples and traditional Chinese architecture.
zh: 許多遊客造訪台南，欣賞那裡的古老廟宇和傳統中式建築。

en: Thousands of fans filled the arena to watch the final basketball game of the season.
zh: 數千名球迷擠滿競技場，觀看本季的最後一場籃球賽。

en: A strange sound from the roof aroused my curiosity, so I went upstairs to take a look.
zh: 屋頂傳來的奇怪聲音激起了我的好奇心，所以我上樓去看看。

en: The night market offers a wide array of snacks, from fried chicken to fresh fruit juice.
zh: 夜市提供各式各樣的小吃，從炸雞到新鮮果汁都有。

en: Nobody wanted to work with Kevin because he was arrogant and never listened to others.
zh: 沒有人想和 Kevin 合作，因為他很傲慢，從不聽別人的意見。

en: It is not always easy to articulate your feelings, especially when you are upset.
zh: 要清楚表達自己的感受並不總是容易，尤其是在你心情不好的時候。

en: In the old story, a poor farmer used an ass to carry heavy bags of rice to town.
zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，一位窮農夫用驢子把一袋袋沉重的米運到鎮上。

en: The news reported that police caught the man soon after his assault on a store clerk.
zh: 新聞報導，那名男子攻擊一名店員後不久就被警方逮捕。

en: One scientist asserted that the new medicine was safe, but other experts wanted more proof.
zh: 一位科學家斷言新藥是安全的，但其他專家想要更多證據。

en: Teachers use quizzes and homework to assess how well students understand each lesson.
zh: 老師用小考和作業來評估學生對每一課的理解程度。

en: Her ability to speak three languages is a great asset when she travels abroad.
zh: 她會說三種語言的能力，是她出國旅行時的一大優勢。

en: Don't make assumptions about people based only on the way they look or dress.
zh: 不要只根據別人的外表或穿著就對他們妄下假設。

en: To our astonishment, the shy new student won first prize in the English speech contest.
zh: 令我們驚訝的是，那位害羞的新同學贏得了英語演講比賽第一名。

en: Lisa joined the school athletics team because she loves running and jumping events.
zh: Lisa 加入學校田徑隊，因為她熱愛跑步和跳躍項目。

en: Class attendance dropped sharply during flu season, with almost ten students absent each day.
zh: 流感季節期間班上出席率大幅下降，每天幾乎有十位同學缺席。

en: We found a box of old family photos in the attic while cleaning the house.
zh: 我們打掃房子時，在閣樓裡發現一盒舊的家庭照片。

en: Before signing the business contract, my uncle asked his attorney to read it carefully.
zh: 簽署這份商業合約之前，我叔叔請他的律師仔細閱讀。

en: Doctors attribute the rise in poor vision among children to too much screen time.
zh: 醫生將兒童視力變差人數增加歸因於使用螢幕時間過長。

en: An old painting by a famous artist was sold at auction for over two million dollars.
zh: 一位知名畫家的舊畫作在拍賣會上以超過兩百萬美元售出。

en: Only the principal can authorize students to leave school early during class hours.
zh: 只有校長可以授權學生在上課時間提早離校。

en: Giving teenagers more autonomy can help them learn to make their own decisions.
zh: 給青少年更多自主權，可以幫助他們學會自己做決定。

en: We stood in awe at the top of the mountain, looking at the sea of clouds below.
zh: 我們站在山頂，滿懷敬畏地看著下方的雲海。

en: Every summer, my family grows tomatoes and other vegetables in our small backyard.
zh: 每年夏天，我家都會在小小的後院種番茄和其他蔬菜。

en: In the class election, each student wrote one name on a ballot and put it in the box.
zh: 在班級選舉中，每位學生在選票上寫下一個名字，然後投進箱子裡。

en: Many cities have decided to ban plastic straws to protect sea animals and the ocean.
zh: 許多城市已決定禁用塑膠吸管，以保護海洋動物和海洋。

en: Students hung a large banner across the school gate to welcome the visiting team.
zh: 學生們在校門上方掛了一條大型橫幅，歡迎來訪的隊伍。

en: After years without rain, the once green fields turned into barren land where nothing could grow.
zh: 經過多年無雨，曾經青翠的田地變成寸草不生的貧瘠土地。

en: Mom baked a batch of cookies for my classmates who helped me prepare for the exam.
zh: 媽媽烤了一批餅乾，送給幫我準備考試的同學們。

en: On behalf of our class, Amy thanked the teacher for her hard work this year.
zh: Amy 代表我們班感謝老師這一年來的辛勞。

en: Passengers are reminded to take all their belongings with them when they leave the train.
zh: 提醒乘客下車時請攜帶所有隨身物品。

en: Every afternoon, the old man read in the garden with his beloved cat beside him.
zh: 那位老先生每天下午都在花園裡看書，他心愛的貓就待在身旁。

en: Drinking enough water and getting enough sleep are both beneficial to your health.
zh: 喝足夠的水和充足的睡眠都對你的健康有益。

en: Emma felt hurt because her best friend had betrayed her by telling others her secret.
zh: Emma 覺得很受傷，因為她最好的朋友把她的祕密告訴別人，背叛了她。

en: Beware of emails that ask for your password, because they are often tricks used by thieves.
zh: 當心要求你提供密碼的電子郵件，因為那些常是竊賊使用的詐騙手法。

en: A good reporter tries to avoid bias and presents the facts from both sides of a story.
zh: 好的記者會試著避免偏見，並呈現事件雙方的事實。

en: At the art sale, a rich buyer made a bid of one million dollars for the old vase.
zh: 藝術品拍賣會上，一位富有的買家對那只古花瓶出價一百萬美元。

en: Scientists are studying the biological changes that happen in our brains when we sleep.
zh: 科學家正在研究我們睡覺時大腦中發生的生物變化。

en: My cat has a bizarre habit of sleeping inside the bathroom sink every afternoon.
zh: 我的貓有個怪異的習慣，每天下午都睡在浴室的洗手台裡。

en: A blast of cold wind hit us as soon as we opened the door on that winter morning.
zh: 那個冬天早晨，我們一打開門，一陣冷風就迎面吹來。

en: Without my glasses, the words on the board are just a blur, so I always sit in front.
zh: 沒戴眼鏡的話，黑板上的字只是一片模糊，所以我總是坐在前面。

en: Mia began to blush when the teacher read her poem aloud to the whole class.
zh: 老師把 Mia 的詩唸給全班聽時，她開始臉紅了。

en: The famous singer walked through the airport with two bodyguards standing close beside her.
zh: 那位知名歌手走過機場，身旁緊跟著兩名保鑣。

en: Before going to bed, Dad always checks that the bolt on the front door is locked.
zh: 睡覺前，爸爸總會檢查前門的門閂是否鎖上了。

en: Workers at the company received a large bonus at the end of the year for their hard work.
zh: 那家公司的員工因為工作努力，在年底獲得一大筆獎金。

en: Thanks to a boom in tourism, many new hotels and restaurants have opened in the small town.
zh: 由於觀光業蓬勃發展，那個小鎮開了許多新的旅館和餐廳。

en: Listening to your favorite music before an exam may help boost your confidence.
zh: 考試前聽你最喜歡的音樂，可能有助於提升你的自信。

en: Our class set up a booth at the school fair to sell cookies we baked ourselves.
zh: 我們班在校園園遊會上設了一個攤位，販賣我們自己烤的餅乾。

en: To fight boredom during the long train ride, Lisa read a novel and listened to music.
zh: 為了打發漫長火車旅程中的無聊，Lisa 看了一本小說並聽音樂。

en: The happy puppy came bounding across the yard to greet us when we got home.
zh: 我們回到家時，那隻快樂的小狗蹦蹦跳跳地穿過院子來迎接我們。

en: This river forms a natural boundary between the two cities, and a long bridge connects them.
zh: 這條河形成兩座城市之間的天然邊界，一座長橋連接著兩地。

en: The young boxer trained for hours every day to prepare for his first big match.
zh: 那位年輕的拳擊手每天訓練好幾個小時，為他的第一場大比賽做準備。

en: Doctors hope the new medicine will be a breakthrough in the fight against cancer.
zh: 醫生們希望這種新藥能成為對抗癌症的一大突破。

en: My father carries his computer and important papers to work in a black leather briefcase.
zh: 我爸爸用一個黑色皮革公事包裝著電腦和重要文件去上班。

en: At the museum, we saw a bronze statue that was made more than two thousand years ago.
zh: 在博物館裡，我們看到一座兩千多年前製作的青銅雕像。

en: I like to browse in the bookstore on weekends, even when I do not plan to buy anything.
zh: 我喜歡週末在書店裡瀏覽，即使我沒打算買任何東西。

en: Amy got a big bruise on her knee after she fell off her bike yesterday.
zh: Amy 昨天從腳踏車上摔下來，膝蓋上多了一大塊瘀青。

en: Buying rice and paper towels in bulk can save your family a lot of money.
zh: 大量購買米和紙巾可以為你家省下很多錢。

en: Our school has clear rules to stop students from trying to bully others online or in person.
zh: 我們學校有明確的規定，防止學生在網路上或當面霸凌他人。

en: The weather bureau warned that a strong typhoon would reach Taiwan on Thursday night.
zh: 氣象局警告，一個強烈颱風將在星期四晚上抵達台灣。

en: Many people complain that bureaucracy makes it slow and difficult to get a simple form approved.
zh: 許多人抱怨官僚體制讓一份簡單的表格要很久又很麻煩才能獲准。

en: In history class, we learned that ancient Egyptian kings prepared for their burial for many years.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到古埃及的國王會花很多年為自己的埋葬做準備。

en: Grandma always buys her pork from the same butcher at the traditional market near our home.
zh: 奶奶總是在我家附近的傳統市場向同一位肉販買豬肉。

en: Milk, cheese, and small fish with bones are good sources of calcium for strong teeth.
zh: 牛奶、起司和帶骨的小魚，都是讓牙齒強健的良好鈣質來源。

en: In Venice, people travel along the canals by boat instead of driving cars on roads.
zh: 在威尼斯，人們搭船沿著運河移動，而不是在馬路上開車。

en: The artist spent three months painting a huge picture of the sea on a large canvas.
zh: 那位藝術家花了三個月，在一大片畫布上畫出一幅巨大的海景畫。

en: Some new phones have the capability to translate spoken words into other languages almost instantly.
zh: 有些新型手機有能力幾乎即時將口語翻譯成其他語言。

en: Planting more trees is one way to reduce the amount of carbon in the air.
zh: 多種樹是減少空氣中碳含量的一種方法。

en: Every February, the city holds a colorful carnival with music, dancing, and street food.
zh: 每年二月，這座城市都會舉辦一場充滿音樂、舞蹈和街頭小吃的繽紛嘉年華。

en: In the novel, a rich man spends all his money in a casino and has to start over.
zh: 在那本小說裡，一個有錢人在賭場花光所有的錢，只好從頭開始。

en: During our trip to Paris, we visited a beautiful cathedral that took nearly two hundred years to build.
zh: 我們去巴黎旅行時，參觀了一座花了將近兩百年才建成的美麗大教堂。

en: Please use caution when you cross the street, especially on rainy nights when drivers cannot see well.
zh: 過馬路時請小心謹慎，尤其是在駕駛看不清楚的雨夜。

en: Doctors are cautious about giving strong medicine to young children because of possible side effects.
zh: 醫生對於給幼童服用強效藥物很謹慎，因為可能有副作用。

en: Many teenagers follow the daily lives of celebrities on social media and copy their fashion style.
zh: 許多青少年在社群媒體上追蹤名人的日常生活，並模仿他們的穿搭風格。

en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, many families visit the cemetery to clean the graves of their family members.
zh: 清明節期間，許多家庭會到墓地清掃家人的墳墓。

en: Parents and teachers gathered in the school hall for the graduation ceremony last Saturday.
zh: 上週六，家長和老師們聚集在學校禮堂參加畢業典禮。

en: Weather experts cannot say with certainty whether the typhoon will hit Taiwan this weekend.
zh: 氣象專家無法確定這個週末颱風是否會侵襲台灣。

en: After finishing the summer course, each student received a certificate with their name on it.
zh: 完成暑期課程後，每位學生都獲得一張印有自己名字的證書。

en: When the fire alarm went off, there was chaos in the hallway as students rushed outside.
zh: 火災警報響起時，學生們衝向外面，走廊上一片混亂。

en: Tourists sat quietly in the small chapel on the hill and listened to the soft music.
zh: 遊客們安靜地坐在山丘上的小教堂裡，聆聽輕柔的音樂。

en: Most of the plants that grow in the desert are characterized by thick leaves that store water.
zh: 大多數生長在沙漠的植物，特性是擁有能儲存水分的厚葉子。

en: The chef at that restaurant uses fresh local vegetables to create simple but delicious dishes.
zh: 那家餐廳的主廚用新鮮的在地蔬菜做出簡單卻美味的料理。

en: Lisa sings in the school choir, and they are practicing hard for the Christmas concert.
zh: Lisa 在學校合唱團唱歌，他們正為聖誕音樂會努力練習。

en: My guitar teacher taught me three basic chords, so now I can play a few simple songs.
zh: 我的吉他老師教了我三個基本和弦，所以現在我能彈幾首簡單的歌了。

en: On weekends, I help my parents with household chores like doing the laundry and taking out the trash.
zh: 週末時，我幫爸媽做家務，例如洗衣服和倒垃圾。

en: Sitting for long hours every day can lead to chronic back pain later in life.
zh: 每天久坐可能會導致日後的慢性背痛。

en: The chubby baby smiled and reached out his little hands toward his mother.
zh: 那個圓嘟嘟的寶寶笑著，朝媽媽伸出小手。

en: A large chunk of ice broke off the mountain and fell into the cold water below.
zh: 一大塊冰從山上斷裂，掉進下方冰冷的水中。

en: In physics class, we built a simple circuit with a battery, some wires, and a small light bulb.
zh: 物理課上，我們用一個電池、幾條電線和一個小燈泡做了一個簡單的電路。

en: In your report, remember to cite the websites and books where you found your information.
zh: 在你的報告中，記得引用你找到資料的網站和書籍。

en: After living in Canada for many years, my aunt finally applied for citizenship there.
zh: 在加拿大住了很多年之後，我阿姨終於申請了當地的公民身分。

en: Cleaning up the park on weekends is a great way for students to show civic pride.
zh: 週末清掃公園是學生展現公民榮譽感的好方法。

en: Our teacher praised Amy's essay for its clarity, saying her ideas were easy to follow.
zh: 老師稱讚 Amy 的作文條理清晰，說她的想法很容易理解。

en: Before you sign any contract, read every clause carefully to make sure you understand it.
zh: 簽任何合約之前，都要仔細閱讀每一項條款，確定你了解內容。

en: The frightened little girl clung to her father's arm during the loud fireworks show.
zh: 在響亮的煙火表演中，那個受到驚嚇的小女孩緊緊抓住爸爸的手臂。

en: Before any new medicine can be sold, it must pass several stages of clinical tests.
zh: 任何新藥在販售之前，都必須通過好幾個階段的臨床試驗。

en: On clear nights, you can see a bright cluster of stars in the eastern sky.
zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，你可以在東邊的天空看到一個明亮的星團。

en: In health class, we learned that cocaine is a dangerous drug that seriously harms the heart and brain.
zh: 在健康課上，我們學到古柯鹼是一種會嚴重傷害心臟和大腦的危險毒品。

en: At the history museum, we saw an ancient wooden coffin that held the body of an Egyptian king.
zh: 在歷史博物館，我們看到一具裝著埃及國王遺體的古代木製棺材。

en: Studies suggest that learning to play music can improve children's cognitive skills, such as memory.
zh: 研究指出，學習演奏音樂可以提升孩子的認知能力，例如記憶力。

en: A good essay should be coherent, with each paragraph clearly connected to the main idea.
zh: 一篇好的文章應該有條理，每一段都要和主旨清楚相連。

en: What a coincidence that Amy and I wore exactly the same dress to the party!
zh: Amy 和我穿了一模一樣的洋裝去派對，真是太巧了！

en: The science project was a successful collaboration between students from three different schools.
zh: 這項科學專題是三所不同學校學生成功合作的成果。

en: Protecting the environment is our collective responsibility, not just the job of the government.
zh: 保護環境是我們的集體責任，不只是政府的工作。

en: My uncle is a stamp collector who owns stamps from more than one hundred countries.
zh: 我叔叔是一位郵票收藏家，擁有來自一百多個國家的郵票。

en: Many buildings in Tainan still show traces of the island's colonial past from about four hundred years ago.
zh: 台南的許多建築仍保有約四百年前島上殖民歷史的痕跡。

en: A newspaper columnist writes a weekly article giving advice to teenagers about school and friendship.
zh: 一位報紙專欄作家每週寫一篇文章，給青少年有關學業和友誼的建議。

en: Scientists are working together to combat the spread of the flu during the winter months.
zh: 科學家們正合力對抗冬季月份的流感傳播。

en: The comedian told so many funny stories that the audience could not stop laughing.
zh: 那位喜劇演員講了好多好笑的故事，讓觀眾笑個不停。

en: We listened to the live commentary on the radio while the baseball game was going on.
zh: 棒球比賽進行時，我們在收音機上聽實況轉播解說。

en: During the game, the TV commentator explained the rules so new fans could understand.
zh: 比賽期間，電視評論員解釋規則，讓新球迷也能看懂。

en: The city set up a special commission to study how to improve public transportation.
zh: 市政府成立了一個特別委員會，研究如何改善大眾運輸。

en: Learning to play the piano well requires a strong commitment and many hours of practice.
zh: 要把鋼琴彈好，需要堅定的投入和許多小時的練習。

en: Coffee and rice are important commodities that are bought and sold all over the world.
zh: 咖啡和稻米是在全世界買賣的重要商品。

en: In history class, we compared communism with other ideas about how a country's economy should work.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們比較共產主義和其他有關國家經濟應如何運作的思想。

en: Our history textbook explains how Russia became a communist country about a hundred years ago.
zh: 我們的歷史課本說明俄羅斯如何在大約一百年前成為一個共產主義國家。

en: My mother commutes to Taipei by train every day, which takes about an hour each way.
zh: 我媽媽每天搭火車通勤到台北，單程大約要一個小時。

en: During rush hour, the trains are packed with commuters going to work or school.
zh: 尖峰時段，列車上擠滿了要去上班或上學的通勤族。

en: This compact camera is small enough to fit in your pocket, so it is perfect for travel.
zh: 這台輕巧的相機小到可以放進口袋，非常適合旅行使用。

en: The price of the new phone is comparable to that of a cheap computer.
zh: 這支新手機的價格和一台便宜的電腦差不多。

en: The nurse showed great compassion for the sick children and comforted them with gentle words.
zh: 那位護理師對生病的孩子們展現極大的同情心，用溫柔的話語安慰他們。

en: Our compassionate teacher stayed after school to help a student whose family was going through hard times.
zh: 我們富有同情心的老師放學後留下來，幫助一位家裡正遭逢困境的學生。

en: Before you download the game, check whether it is compatible with your phone.
zh: 下載這款遊戲之前，先確認它是否和你的手機相容。

en: Heavy rain compelled the school to cancel the outdoor sports day and move some events indoors.
zh: 大雨迫使學校取消戶外運動會，並將部分項目移到室內舉行。

en: The airline offered free meals to compensate passengers for the five-hour delay.
zh: 航空公司提供免費餐點，以補償乘客延誤五小時的損失。

en: After the flood damaged their homes, the families received compensation from the government.
zh: 洪水毀損他們的房子之後，這些家庭獲得了政府的補償。

en: The job interview is a chance for you to show your competence in both English and computers.
zh: 工作面試是你展現英文和電腦兩方面能力的機會。

en: My aunt is a competent manager who always finishes projects on time and never seems nervous.
zh: 我阿姨是一位能幹的經理，總是準時完成計畫，從來不顯得緊張。

en: The complexity of the math problem made even the top students in our class stop and think.
zh: 這道數學題的複雜性，讓我們班上最頂尖的學生也停下來思考。

en: Strict compliance with safety rules is necessary for everyone who works in the science lab.
zh: 每個在科學實驗室工作的人，都必須嚴格遵守安全規定。

en: Doctors watched the patient closely after the operation to make sure there were no complications.
zh: 手術後醫生密切觀察病人，確保沒有出現併發症。

en: Lisa smiled shyly when her teacher paid her a compliment on her excellent English speech.
zh: 老師稱讚 Lisa 的英語演講非常出色時，她害羞地笑了。

en: All visitors to the museum must comply with the rule against taking photos with a flash.
zh: 所有博物館的參觀者都必須遵守禁止使用閃光燈拍照的規定。

en: Trust and honesty are the most important components of a lasting friendship.
zh: 信任和誠實是長久友誼中最重要的成分。

en: Water is a compound made of two kinds of elements, hydrogen and oxygen.
zh: 水是由氫和氧兩種元素組成的化合物。

en: The little boy was too young to comprehend why his grandfather was in the hospital.
zh: 那個小男孩年紀太小，無法理解爺爺為什麼住院。

en: Reading English news every day is a good way to improve your reading comprehension.
zh: 每天閱讀英文新聞是提升閱讀理解力的好方法。

en: Our school volleyball team is comprised of twelve players from different grades.
zh: 我們學校的排球隊由十二名來自不同年級的球員組成。

en: My sister wanted pizza and I wanted noodles, so we made a compromise and ordered both.
zh: 我姊姊想吃披薩，我想吃麵，所以我們各退一步，兩樣都點了。

en: In Taiwan, English is a compulsory subject for all junior and senior high school students.
zh: 在台灣，英文是所有國中和高中學生的必修科目。

en: Amy tried to conceal her disappointment with a smile when she did not win the contest.
zh: Amy 沒有贏得比賽時，試著用微笑掩飾她的失望。

en: After a long debate, Tom finally conceded that his classmate's idea was better than his own.
zh: 經過一番長時間的辯論，Tom 終於承認同學的想法比他自己的好。

en: A young engineer conceived the idea for a phone game while waiting for a bus in the rain.
zh: 一位年輕的工程師在雨中等公車時，構想出一款手機遊戲的點子。

en: The artist's conception of a future city included tall towers covered with trees and gardens.
zh: 那位藝術家對未來城市的構想，包括覆蓋著樹木和花園的高塔。

en: World leaders condemned the attack on the hospital and called for peace in the area.
zh: 世界各國領袖譴責對醫院的攻擊，並呼籲該地區恢復和平。

en: Scientists conducted an experiment to find out how music affects the growth of plants.
zh: 科學家進行了一項實驗，想找出音樂如何影響植物的生長。

en: In the story, the boy made a confession to his mother that he had broken her favorite cup.
zh: 在故事裡，男孩向媽媽坦白，是他打破了她最喜歡的杯子。

en: Doctors must keep their patients' medical records confidential and never share them with strangers.
zh: 醫生必須對病人的病歷保密，絕不能和陌生人分享。

en: Because of the high fever, Ben was confined to bed for three days and missed his exams.
zh: 因為發高燒，Ben 只能臥床三天，錯過了考試。

en: Students who do not conform to the school's dress code may be asked to change their clothes.
zh: 不遵守學校服裝規定的學生，可能會被要求換衣服。

en: At some point, we all have to confront our fears, whether it is speaking in public or swimming.
zh: 在某個時候，我們都必須面對自己的恐懼，不論是公開演講還是游泳。

en: To avoid a confrontation, Mia quietly walked away when the angry customer started shouting.
zh: 為了避免衝突，當那位生氣的顧客開始大吼時，Mia 默默地走開了。

en: It rained for five consecutive days, so our class had to cancel the picnic.
zh: 雨連續下了五天，所以我們班只好取消野餐。

en: After an hour of discussion, the class reached a consensus on the theme of the school play.
zh: 經過一小時的討論，全班對學校話劇的主題達成了共識。

en: Students under eighteen need written consent from their parents to join the overnight school trip.
zh: 未滿十八歲的學生需要家長的書面同意，才能參加過夜的校外教學。

en: The conservation of forests is important because they provide homes for many kinds of animals.
zh: 森林保育很重要，因為森林為許多種動物提供棲息地。

en: It was considerate of Lisa to bring hot soup to her neighbor who was sick in bed.
zh: Lisa 帶熱湯給臥病在床的鄰居，真是體貼。

en: In social studies class, we discussed the constitutional rights that protect freedom of speech.
zh: 在社會課上，我們討論了保障言論自由的憲法權利。

en: Because of time constraints, each group can only give a five-minute report in class.
zh: 由於時間限制，每一組在課堂上只能做五分鐘的報告。

en: After a short consultation with the doctor, my mother decided to change her diet.
zh: 和醫生簡短諮詢後，我媽媽決定改變她的飲食。

en: Turning off lights when you leave a room can reduce your family's electricity consumption.
zh: 離開房間時關燈，可以減少你家的用電量。

en: The flu is highly contagious, so students who are sick should stay home and rest.
zh: 流感的傳染性很高，所以生病的學生應該待在家休息。

en: Waste from the factory contaminated the river, and many fish died within a week.
zh: 工廠排出的廢棄物污染了河川，許多魚在一週內死亡。

en: Sitting by the lake, the old man contemplated the changes in his life over the past fifty years.
zh: 那位老先生坐在湖邊，沉思著過去五十年來人生中的變化。

en: The museum is holding a show of contemporary art by young artists from around Asia.
zh: 博物館正在舉辦一場展覽，展出來自亞洲各地年輕藝術家的當代藝術作品。

en: The rude customer looked at the young waiter with contempt and refused to say thank you.
zh: 那位無禮的顧客輕蔑地看著年輕服務生，不肯說謝謝。

en: Some scientists contend that playing video games can actually improve teenagers' problem-solving skills.
zh: 有些科學家主張，玩電子遊戲其實能提升青少年解決問題的能力。

en: Many birds fly from the cold continental areas of northern Asia to Taiwan for the winter.
zh: 許多鳥類從亞洲北部寒冷的大陸地區飛到台灣過冬。

en: My parents hired a contractor to repair the roof and fix the windows of our old house.
zh: 我爸媽雇了一位承包商來修理我們老房子的屋頂和窗戶。

en: There is a contradiction between what he says about saving the earth and his love of plastic bags.
zh: 他說要拯救地球，卻又熱愛使用塑膠袋，這之間有矛盾。

en: Whether students should be allowed to use phones in class is a controversial topic at many schools.
zh: 學生是否應該被允許在課堂上使用手機，在許多學校是一個有爭議的話題。

en: The new building plan caused a lot of controversy because it meant cutting down hundreds of old trees.
zh: 新的建築計畫引起很大的爭議，因為這代表要砍掉數百棵老樹。

en: Solar panels allow the conversion of energy from the sun into electricity for homes.
zh: 太陽能板能將太陽的能量轉換成家庭用的電力。

en: The old factory was converted into a modern art museum that attracts many young visitors.
zh: 那座老工廠被改建成一間吸引許多年輕遊客的現代美術館。

en: In the novel, a man was convicted of a crime he never committed and spent years in prison.
zh: 在那本小說中，一名男子被判了一項他沒有犯下的罪，並在監獄裡待了好幾年。

en: Amy spoke with conviction about the importance of protecting sea turtles from plastic waste.
zh: Amy 堅定地談論保護海龜免受塑膠垃圾危害的重要性。

en: Our class leader helped coordinate the work so that every group member had a clear task.
zh: 我們的班長協助協調工作，讓每位組員都有明確的任務。

en: You should not copy and share other people's music online without permission, because it breaks copyright laws.
zh: 你不應該未經許可在網路上複製和分享別人的音樂，因為這違反版權法。

en: Respect for others is at the core of our school's values, and teachers remind us of it daily.
zh: 尊重他人是我們學校價值觀的核心，老師每天都會提醒我們。

en: Many companies give money to schools as part of their corporate plan to help local communities.
zh: 許多公司捐錢給學校，作為他們幫助當地社區的企業計畫之一。

en: My aunt works for a large corporation that sells computer parts to countries all over the world.
zh: 我阿姨在一家大企業工作，這家公司將電腦零件賣到世界各國。

en: Researchers found a strong correlation between the amount of sleep students get and their test scores.
zh: 研究人員發現，學生的睡眠量和他們的考試成績之間有很強的相關性。

en: A correspondent from the TV station reported live from the area hit by the earthquake.
zh: 電視台的一位特派記者在地震災區進行現場報導。

en: Students are not allowed to run in the corridor, because someone might get hurt.
zh: 學生不可以在走廊上奔跑，因為可能有人會受傷。

en: The people of the city were angry at the corrupt officials who took money from big companies.
zh: 市民對那些收受大公司金錢的腐敗官員感到憤怒。

en: The newspaper story about corruption in the city government shocked many people.
zh: 那則關於市政府貪腐的新聞報導震驚了許多人。

en: When Mia felt worried about her future, she asked her teacher for counsel.
zh: 當 Mia 對自己的未來感到擔憂時，她向老師尋求建議。

en: If you are feeling stressed about exams, you can always talk to the school counselor.
zh: 如果你對考試感到壓力很大，隨時都可以找學校的輔導老師談談。

en: The hotel staff were courteous and helpful, so we had a very pleasant stay.
zh: 飯店員工彬彬有禮又樂於助人，所以我們住得非常愉快。

en: News coverage of the typhoon continued all night as the storm moved across the island.
zh: 颱風橫越全島期間，新聞媒體整夜持續報導。

en: The website lost its credibility after people discovered that many of its stories were false.
zh: 大家發現那個網站的許多報導都是假的之後，它便失去了可信度。

en: We took off our shoes and walked through the cool water of the creek behind the village.
zh: 我們脫掉鞋子，走過村子後方小溪裡清涼的溪水。

en: The heavy snow crippled the city, closing roads, schools, and the airport for two days.
zh: 那場大雪使城市陷入癱瘓，道路、學校和機場都關閉了兩天。

en: Creativity is one important criterion the judges use to choose the best works in the art contest.
zh: 創意是評審選出美術比賽最佳作品的一項重要標準。

en: Getting enough sleep is crucial for teenagers because their brains are still growing.
zh: 充足的睡眠對青少年至關重要，因為他們的大腦仍在發育。

en: Crude oil must be cleaned and treated before it can be used as fuel for cars.
zh: 原油必須經過淨化和處理，才能用作汽車的燃料。

en: For their wedding anniversary, my grandfather and grandmother went on a cruise to Japan.
zh: 為了慶祝結婚紀念日，我的祖父母搭郵輪去日本旅行。

en: When the sun shone through the crystal glass, it made tiny rainbows on the wall.
zh: 陽光照進水晶玻璃時，在牆上映出小小的彩虹。

en: Many tourists come to Taiwan to enjoy its local cuisine, especially the snacks at night markets.
zh: 許多遊客來台灣品嘗當地的美食，尤其是夜市的小吃。

en: Before traveling to Japan, we changed some Taiwan dollars into the local currency at the bank.
zh: 去日本旅行之前，我們在銀行把一些新台幣換成當地貨幣。

en: The new curriculum gives high school students more chances to choose classes based on their interests.
zh: 新課綱讓高中生有更多機會依照自己的興趣選修課程。

en: The police took the man into custody after a camera recorded him stealing a bike.
zh: 監視器拍到那名男子偷腳踏車後，警方將他拘留。

en: When we landed in Tokyo, we had to go through customs after picking up our luggage.
zh: 我們降落在東京時，領完行李後還必須通過海關。

en: Some mushrooms in the forest look harmless, but they actually contain a deadly poison.
zh: 森林裡有些菇類看起來無害，但其實含有致命的毒素。

en: After the typhoon, volunteers spent the whole day clearing debris from the beach.
zh: 颱風過後，志工花了一整天清理海灘上的殘骸碎片。

en: The young singer made her debut on a TV talent show when she was only fifteen.
zh: 這位年輕歌手年僅十五歲時，就在電視選秀節目上首次亮相。

en: Eating too much sugar without brushing your teeth regularly can lead to tooth decay.
zh: 吃太多糖又不定期刷牙，可能會導致蛀牙。

en: Some online ads deceive buyers with photos that look much better than the real products.
zh: 有些網路廣告用比實際商品好看得多的照片欺騙消費者。

en: After working hard for many years, Mr. Lin finally found a job with a decent salary.
zh: 努力工作多年後，林先生終於找到一份薪水像樣的工作。

en: In history class, we read the Declaration of Independence, which was signed in 1776.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們讀了簽署於 1776 年的《獨立宣言》。

en: The number of students in country schools has declined sharply over the past ten years.
zh: 過去十年來，鄉下學校的學生人數大幅下降。

en: Dr. Chen has dedicated her whole life to protecting sea turtles along Taiwan's coast.
zh: 陳博士將她的一生奉獻給保護台灣沿岸的海龜。

en: In court, the defendant listened quietly as the judge read the final decision.
zh: 在法庭上，被告靜靜聆聽法官宣讀最終判決。

en: The city is facing a huge budget deficit, so several new building projects have been delayed.
zh: 該市正面臨龐大的預算赤字，所以好幾項新建工程都延後了。

en: The little boy defied his parents' warning and climbed the tall tree behind the house.
zh: 小男孩違抗父母的警告，爬上了屋後那棵高大的樹。

en: Each class chose one delegate to attend the student council meeting with the principal.
zh: 每班選出一位代表，與校長一起出席學生會會議。

en: A delegation of high school students from Japan visited our school to learn about Taiwanese culture.
zh: 一個來自日本的高中生代表團參訪我們學校，以了解台灣文化。

en: It wasn't an accident; Tom made a deliberate choice to skip practice and go shopping instead.
zh: 這不是意外；Tom 是故意選擇翹掉練習去逛街的。

en: As a true democrat, Mr. Wu believes every student should have an equal vote in class decisions.
zh: 身為真正的民主主義者，吳老師相信每位學生在班級決策中都應有平等的投票權。

en: Despite clear evidence, the company issued a denial that its factory had polluted the river.
zh: 儘管證據確鑿，那家公司仍發表聲明，否認其工廠汙染了河川。

en: Taipei has a high population density, so many families live in small apartments.
zh: 台北的人口密度很高，所以許多家庭住在小公寓裡。

en: This painting depicts daily life in a small fishing village about two hundred years ago.
zh: 這幅畫描繪了大約兩百年前一個小漁村的日常生活。

en: The government deployed hundreds of rescue workers to the area right after the earthquake.
zh: 地震發生後，政府立刻在該地區部署了數百名救難人員。

en: Weeks of rainy weather can really depress people and make them feel tired all the time.
zh: 連續好幾週的雨天真的會讓人心情低落，總是覺得疲倦。

en: While the manager is on vacation, her deputy will handle all the important decisions in the office.
zh: 經理休假期間，她的副手會處理辦公室裡所有重要的決定。

en: Many English words are derived from Latin, so learning word roots can help you guess meanings.
zh: 許多英文字源自拉丁文，所以學習字根能幫助你猜出字義。

en: As the plane began to descend, we could see the bright lights of the city below.
zh: 當飛機開始下降時，我們可以看見下方城市明亮的燈光。

en: Our English teacher asked us to write a descriptive paragraph about our favorite place in town.
zh: 英文老師要我們寫一段描述性的段落，介紹我們在鎮上最喜歡的地方。

en: After failing the exam twice, Jenny almost gave up in despair, but her friends encouraged her.
zh: 考試兩次不及格後，Jenny 在絕望中幾乎要放棄，但朋友們鼓勵了她。

en: Kyoto is a popular travel destination because of its beautiful temples and quiet old streets.
zh: 京都因為美麗的寺廟和寧靜的老街，成為熱門的旅遊目的地。

en: She believes it was destiny that brought her to the small town where she found her dream job.
zh: 她相信是命運把她帶到那座小鎮，讓她在那裡找到夢想中的工作。

en: Typhoons can be extremely destructive, damaging houses, roads, and farms within a few hours.
zh: 颱風的破壞力可能極強，在幾小時內就能毀損房屋、道路和農田。

en: The nurse's devotion to her patients earned her the respect of everyone in the hospital.
zh: 這位護理師對病人的奉獻，贏得了醫院裡每個人的敬重。

en: The doctor diagnosed Amy with a mild stomach illness and told her to rest for two days.
zh: 醫生診斷出 Amy 患有輕微的腸胃疾病，要她休息兩天。

en: Early diagnosis of a disease can greatly increase a patient's chance of a full recovery.
zh: 及早診斷疾病，可以大大提高病人完全康復的機會。

en: My grandmother speaks a local dialect that I can understand but can't speak very well.
zh: 我奶奶說一種地方方言，我聽得懂，但說得不太好。

en: The diameter of this round table is about two meters, so it can seat ten people.
zh: 這張圓桌的直徑大約兩公尺，所以可以坐十個人。

en: My aunt changed the baby's diaper and then sang her a song until she fell asleep.
zh: 阿姨幫寶寶換了尿布，然後唱歌給她聽，直到她睡著。

en: Eating slowly and chewing your food well can help your digestion and prevent stomachaches.
zh: 細嚼慢嚥有助於消化，並且可以預防胃痛。

en: Lisa faced a dilemma: should she tell the teacher about her best friend's cheating or stay silent?
zh: Lisa 陷入兩難：她該把好友作弊的事告訴老師，還是保持沉默？

en: Climate change has many dimensions, including science, money, and the way people live.
zh: 氣候變遷有許多面向，包括科學、金錢以及人們的生活方式。

en: As the medicine began to work, the pain in his leg gradually diminished.
zh: 隨著藥物開始發揮作用，他腿上的疼痛逐漸減輕了。

en: The two countries have kept close diplomatic relations for decades, sharing both trade and culture.
zh: 這兩個國家數十年來一直維持密切的外交關係，在貿易和文化上互相交流。

en: You can find the phone number of every teacher in the school directory on the website.
zh: 你可以在學校網站的名錄中找到每位老師的電話號碼。

en: My parents disapprove of my staying up late to play video games on school nights.
zh: 我爸媽不贊成我在隔天要上學的晚上熬夜打電動。

en: The hospital will never disclose a patient's personal information without his or her permission.
zh: 未經病人同意，醫院絕不會揭露病人的個人資料。

en: Before cleaning the electric fan, make sure you disconnect it from the power supply.
zh: 清潔電風扇之前，務必先切斷它的電源。

en: The professor's discourse on happiness made the students think deeply about what really matters in life.
zh: 教授關於幸福的論述，讓學生們深入思考人生中真正重要的是什麼。

en: Companies should not discriminate against job seekers because of their age or gender.
zh: 公司不應因為年齡或性別而歧視求職者。

en: Many people still face discrimination at work simply because of the color of their skin.
zh: 許多人仍然只因為膚色而在職場上遭受歧視。

en: Heavy snow disrupted train services across the country, leaving thousands of passengers stuck at stations.
zh: 大雪擾亂了全國的火車運行，使數千名旅客受困車站。

en: Stir the water until the sugar completely dissolves, and then add a little lemon juice.
zh: 攪拌開水直到糖完全溶解，然後加入一點檸檬汁。

en: Young children often find it hard to make a distinction between dreams and reality.
zh: 年幼的孩子常常很難區別夢境和現實。

en: Each bird species has a distinctive song that helps scientists identify it in the forest.
zh: 每種鳥都有獨特的叫聲，能幫助科學家在森林中辨認牠們。

en: Checking your phone while studying can easily distract you and make you learn less.
zh: 讀書時查看手機很容易讓你分心，學到的東西也會變少。

en: The monks spent years studying the religious doctrines written in ancient books.
zh: 僧侶們花了多年時間研讀古書中記載的宗教教義。

en: Please bring your passport and other important documents when you go to the office to apply.
zh: 去辦公室申請時，請攜帶護照和其他重要文件。

en: We watched a documentary about penguins and learned how melting ice affects their lives.
zh: 我們看了一部關於企鵝的紀錄片，了解到融冰如何影響牠們的生活。

en: Artificial intelligence is no longer just the domain of scientists; it affects everyone's daily life.
zh: 人工智慧不再只是科學家的領域，它影響著每個人的日常生活。

en: The old church has a huge white dome that can be seen from miles away.
zh: 那座古老的教堂有一個巨大的白色圓頂，從好幾英里外就能看見。

en: Our class decided to donate the money from the bake sale to a local animal shelter.
zh: 我們班決定把義賣烘焙點心的收入捐給當地的動物收容所。

en: Thanks to generous donations from the public, the library was able to buy thousands of new books.
zh: 多虧社會大眾的慷慨捐款，圖書館得以購買數千本新書。

en: Blood donors in Taiwan must be healthy and at least seventeen years old.
zh: 在台灣，捐血者必須身體健康且年滿十七歲。

en: The cat sat in the doorway, refusing to go either inside or outside the house.
zh: 貓坐在門口，既不肯進屋也不肯出去。

en: Grandma taught me how to roll the dough into thin pieces for making dumplings.
zh: 奶奶教我怎麼把麵團擀成薄片來包水餃。

en: We had a dreadful trip because it rained every day and the hotel room was dirty.
zh: 我們這趟旅行糟透了，因為每天都下雨，飯店房間又髒。

en: Dad parked the car in the driveway and carried the heavy boxes into the house.
zh: 爸爸把車停在私人車道上，然後把重重的箱子搬進屋裡。

en: The long drought this spring forced farmers to stop growing rice in some areas.
zh: 今年春天的長期乾旱，迫使某些地區的農民停止種稻。

en: Building a factory beside the lake could cause serious ecological damage to the birds living there.
zh: 在湖邊蓋工廠可能會對住在那裡的鳥類造成嚴重的生態破壞。

en: My sister is studying ecology in college because she wants to protect forests and wild animals.
zh: 我姊姊在大學讀生態學，因為她想保護森林和野生動物。

en: Rain forests are rich ecosystems that provide homes for millions of kinds of plants and animals.
zh: 雨林是豐富的生態系，為數百萬種動植物提供棲身之所。

en: Losing the final game hurt his ego, but he soon learned to accept the result calmly.
zh: 輸掉決賽傷了他的自尊，但他很快就學會平靜地接受結果。

en: Mia spent three hours preparing an elaborate birthday cake decorated with fresh fruit and flowers.
zh: Mia 花了三個小時準備一個精心製作、以新鮮水果和花朵裝飾的生日蛋糕。

en: Students with an average grade above 85 are eligible for the school's scholarship.
zh: 平均成績在 85 分以上的學生，有資格申請學校的獎學金。

en: The class leader gave an eloquent speech that moved many teachers and students to tears.
zh: 班長發表了一場極具說服力的演講，讓許多師生感動落淚。

en: She embraced her grandmother at the airport after not seeing her for two whole years.
zh: 整整兩年沒見後，她在機場擁抱了奶奶。

en: Many cities are trying to reduce car emissions by encouraging people to take buses and ride bikes.
zh: 許多城市正透過鼓勵民眾搭公車和騎自行車，來減少汽車的廢氣排放。

en: Several famous doctors endorsed the new program that teaches children healthy eating habits.
zh: 好幾位知名醫師都贊同這項教導孩童健康飲食習慣的新計畫。

en: The government offers loans to help small and medium-sized enterprises grow their businesses.
zh: 政府提供貸款，幫助中小企業拓展業務。

en: The students were enthusiastic about the school trip and talked about it for weeks.
zh: 學生們對校外教學充滿熱情，接連好幾個星期都在談論這件事。

en: Every child is entitled to a free basic education, no matter how rich or poor the family is.
zh: 無論家庭貧富，每個孩子都有權接受免費的基礎教育。

en: After the two companies joined together, they became a single entity with one new name.
zh: 兩家公司合併後，成為一個擁有新名稱的單一實體。

en: At just twenty-two, the young entrepreneur opened her own bakery selling healthy bread.
zh: 這位年輕的企業家年僅二十二歲，就開了自己的麵包店，專賣健康麵包。

en: Amy felt a little envious when her best friend got the leading role in the school play.
zh: 當最好的朋友在學校話劇中拿到主角時，Amy 覺得有點羨慕。

en: Our principal envisions a green campus where students grow vegetables and plant trees together.
zh: 我們校長展望一個綠色校園，讓學生們一起種菜、種樹。

en: Health officials are worried that the flu epidemic will spread quickly in crowded schools this winter.
zh: 衛生官員擔心今年冬天流感疫情會在擁擠的校園中迅速蔓延。

en: I stayed up late last night to watch the final episode of my favorite TV drama.
zh: 我昨晚熬夜看我最喜歡的電視劇的最後一集。

en: Our math teacher showed us a quicker way to solve this kind of equation.
zh: 我們的數學老師教我們一個更快解這類方程式的方法。

en: The new policy aims to promote equity so that students in poor areas get the same chances.
zh: 這項新政策旨在促進公平，讓貧困地區的學生也能獲得相同的機會。

en: Drinking one cup of this sweet milk tea is equivalent to eating ten spoons of sugar.
zh: 喝一杯這種甜奶茶，等於吃下十匙糖。

en: Workers erected a huge tent in the park for the weekend music festival.
zh: 工人們在公園裡豎立了一座巨大的帳篷，準備週末的音樂節。

en: My mom asked me to run an errand and buy some eggs at the store down the street.
zh: 媽媽要我跑個腿，去街上那家店買些蛋。

en: Mount Fuji last erupted in 1707, covering towns as far away as Tokyo with ash.
zh: 富士山上一次爆發是在 1707 年，火山灰甚至覆蓋了遠在東京的城鎮。

en: Please hold on and stand still when you ride the escalator in the train station.
zh: 在火車站搭電扶梯時，請握好扶手並站穩。

en: The essence of true friendship is trust, not how much time you spend together.
zh: 真正友誼的本質是信任，而不是你們相處多少時間。

en: After his grandfather passed away, Mr. Lee received a large estate in the countryside.
zh: 祖父過世後，李先生得到鄉間一大片地產。

en: Many ancient kings searched for the secret of eternal life, but none of them found it.
zh: 許多古代君王都在尋找永生的祕密，但沒有一個人找到。

en: Doctors must follow a strict code of ethics to protect their patients' rights and privacy.
zh: 醫生必須遵守嚴格的倫理規範，以保護病人的權利和隱私。

en: Is it ethical to test new beauty products on animals? Our class had a lively debate about it.
zh: 用動物測試新的美妝產品合乎倫理嗎？我們班對此進行了一場熱烈的辯論。

en: Darwin's theory of evolution explains how living things change slowly over millions of years.
zh: 達爾文的演化論解釋了生物如何在數百萬年間緩慢改變。

en: Scientists believe that whales evolved from land animals that lived near the sea long ago.
zh: 科學家相信，鯨魚是從很久以前住在海邊的陸地動物演化而來的。

en: Saying that Ben eats ten bowls of rice a day is an exaggeration, but he eats a lot.
zh: 說 Ben 一天吃十碗飯是誇張了點，但他的確吃很多。

en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit on this road will have to pay a heavy fine.
zh: 在這條路上超速的駕駛人將被處以高額罰款。

en: Lisa showed exceptional talent in music and won first prize in the national piano contest.
zh: Lisa 展現了傑出的音樂天分，在全國鋼琴比賽中獲得第一名。

en: Excessive use of phones before bed can make it much harder for teenagers to fall asleep.
zh: 睡前過度使用手機，會讓青少年更難入睡。

en: "What a beautiful view!" Mia exclaimed when she finally reached the top of the mountain.
zh: 「好美的景色！」Mia 終於登上山頂時驚呼道。

en: Nobody should be excluded from the game just because they are new to the class.
zh: 沒有人應該只因為剛轉進班上就被排除在遊戲之外。

en: Members get exclusive use of the club's swimming pool and can take free dance classes.
zh: 會員可以獨享俱樂部的游泳池，還能免費上舞蹈課。

en: Our team carefully executed the plan, and the school fair went smoothly from start to finish.
zh: 我們團隊仔細執行計畫，校慶園遊會從頭到尾都進行得很順利。

en: Good ideas are important, but careful execution is what really makes a project succeed.
zh: 好點子固然重要，但細心的執行才是讓計畫成功的真正關鍵。

en: The company's top executives held a meeting to discuss how to attract more young customers.
zh: 公司的高階主管開會討論如何吸引更多年輕顧客。

en: The famous poet Su Shi was sent into exile several times, yet he kept writing cheerful poems.
zh: 著名詩人蘇軾多次遭到流放，卻仍持續寫出開朗的詩作。

en: The night market sells exotic fruits from Southeast Asia that most of us have never tasted.
zh: 夜市賣著來自東南亞、我們大多數人從沒嚐過的異國水果。

en: A group of scientists joined an expedition to the South Pole to study how ice is melting.
zh: 一群科學家參加了前往南極的探險，研究冰層融化的情形。

en: We asked Mr. Wang for help because of his expertise in computer programming.
zh: 我們向王先生求助，因為他具備電腦程式設計的專業知識。

en: Ms. Huang gave us explicit instructions about how long the report should be and when it was due.
zh: 黃老師給了我們明確的指示，說明報告該寫多長以及何時要交。

en: Some factories exploit young workers by making them work long hours for very little pay.
zh: 有些工廠剝削年輕勞工，讓他們長時間工作卻只領微薄的薪水。

en: Space exploration has helped scientists learn more about how the universe began.
zh: 太空探索幫助科學家更了解宇宙是如何誕生的。

en: Our teacher agreed to give us a one-week extension on the history project.
zh: 老師同意讓我們的歷史專題延後一週繳交。

en: Last week's typhoon caused extensive damage to farms and roads in southern Taiwan.
zh: 上週的颱風對南台灣的農田和道路造成大範圍的損害。

en: The exterior of the old building was painted bright blue, but the inside still looked old.
zh: 那棟老建築的外部漆成了亮藍色，但內部看起來依然老舊。

en: This medicine is for external use only, so never put it in your mouth.
zh: 這種藥僅供外用，所以絕對不要放進嘴裡。

en: Dinosaurs became extinct about sixty-six million years ago, possibly after a huge rock hit Earth.
zh: 恐龍大約在六千六百萬年前滅絕，可能是因為一顆巨大的岩石撞擊地球。

en: The young runner showed extraordinary courage when she kept racing despite a hurt foot.
zh: 這位年輕跑者展現了非凡的勇氣，即使腳受傷仍繼續比賽。

en: This shirt is made of a soft fabric that keeps you cool on hot summer days.
zh: 這件襯衫是用柔軟的布料做的，能讓你在炎熱的夏天保持涼爽。

en: We had a fabulous time at the beach, swimming and watching the sun go down together.
zh: 我們在海灘玩得超開心，一起游泳、看夕陽西下。

en: Clear signs in several languages facilitate travel for foreign visitors in the city.
zh: 用多種語言標示的清楚指標，讓外國遊客在城市裡旅行更加便利。

en: All faculty members are invited to a meeting to discuss changes to next year's class schedule.
zh: 全體教職員受邀參加會議，討論明年課表的調整。

en: Stars have always fascinated my little brother, so he hopes to study space in the future.
zh: 星星一直讓我弟弟深深著迷，所以他希望將來能研究太空。

en: After running the marathon, Kevin felt extreme fatigue and slept for twelve hours.
zh: 跑完馬拉松後，Kevin 感到極度疲勞，睡了十二個小時。

en: In the United States, the federal government handles national matters, while each state makes its own local laws.
zh: 在美國，聯邦政府處理全國性事務，而各州則制定自己的地方法律。

en: Fruits, vegetables, and whole grains are rich in fiber, which helps keep your stomach healthy.
zh: 水果、蔬菜和全穀類富含纖維，有助於維持腸胃健康。

en: We use a water filter at home to remove dirt and harmful chemicals from tap water.
zh: 我們家用濾水器去除自來水中的雜質和有害化學物質。

en: Officials announced the city's fiscal plan, which includes more spending on education next year.
zh: 官員公布了市政府的財政計畫，其中包括明年增加教育支出。

en: A fleet of fishing boats returned to the harbor just before the storm arrived.
zh: 一支漁船隊就在暴風雨來臨前返回港口。

en: Stretching every morning can improve your body's flexibility and reduce the risk of injury.
zh: 每天早上做伸展運動，可以提升身體的柔軟度，並降低受傷的風險。

en: Wait until small bubbles appear, and then flip the pancake over to cook the other side.
zh: 等到小氣泡出現，再把鬆餅翻面煎另一邊。

en: Reading English news every day has greatly improved Amy's fluency in the language.
zh: 每天閱讀英文新聞，大大提升了 Amy 的英語流利度。

en: When you have a fever, it's important to drink plenty of fluids and get enough rest.
zh: 發燒時，多喝水分並充分休息是很重要的。

en: Through years of working together, the two teams forged a close friendship.
zh: 經過多年的合作，這兩支團隊建立起深厚的友誼。

en: Please save your report in PDF format before you send it to the teacher.
zh: 寄給老師之前，請把報告存成 PDF 格式。

en: Our school held an open forum where students could share their ideas about the new dress code.
zh: 我們學校舉辦了一場公開論壇，讓學生分享對新服儀規定的想法。

en: Over the years, the Lins have cared for three foster children who needed a safe and loving home.
zh: 這些年來，林家照顧過三個需要安全溫暖家庭的寄養孩子。

en: A foul smell came from the trash can that nobody had emptied for a week.
zh: 那個整整一週沒人倒的垃圾桶傳出一股惡臭。

en: Only a small fraction of the plastic we use every day is actually recycled.
zh: 我們每天使用的塑膠中，只有一小部分真正被回收。

en: Workers found fragments of old bowls buried under the temple, showing that people lived there long ago.
zh: 工人在寺廟底下挖到古老碗盤的碎片，顯示很久以前就有人住在那裡。

en: This new law provides a framework for protecting people's personal information online.
zh: 這項新法律為保護民眾的網路個人資料提供了一個架構。

en: My uncle bought a franchise of a popular coffee chain and opened a shop near our school.
zh: 我叔叔買下一家知名咖啡連鎖店的加盟權，在我們學校附近開了一家店。

en: A man was arrested for fraud after cheating elderly people out of their life savings.
zh: 一名男子詐騙老人的畢生積蓄後，因詐欺罪被捕。

en: Most freight between the two islands is carried by large ships rather than airplanes.
zh: 兩座島之間的貨運大多由大型船隻而非飛機運送。

en: Deep oceans remain one of the last frontiers that scientists have not fully explored.
zh: 深海仍是科學家尚未完全探索的最後前沿之一。

en: Our sun is just one of billions of stars in the Milky Way galaxy.
zh: 我們的太陽只是銀河系數千億顆恆星中的一顆。

en: Everyone in the audience gasped when the dancer jumped high into the air and landed perfectly.
zh: 當舞者高高躍起又完美落地時，全場觀眾都倒抽了一口氣。

en: Chinese New Year is a time for family gatherings and big dinners with relatives.
zh: 農曆新年是家人團聚、和親戚一起吃大餐的時候。

en: Solar panels on our school roof generate enough electricity to power all the classrooms.
zh: 我們學校屋頂上的太陽能板產生的電力，足夠供應所有教室使用。

en: When the power went out, the hospital used a generator to keep its machines running.
zh: 停電時，醫院使用發電機讓機器持續運作。

en: Some diseases are genetic, which means they can be passed from parents to their children.
zh: 有些疾病是遺傳性的，也就是說會由父母傳給子女。

en: Thanks to advances in genetics, doctors can now find certain diseases before a baby is born.
zh: 多虧遺傳學的進步，醫生現在能在寶寶出生前就發現某些疾病。

en: Fantasy is my favorite genre of fiction because it takes me to magical worlds.
zh: 奇幻是我最喜歡的小說類型，因為它能帶我進入魔法世界。

en: Mr. Chang glared at the two students who were whispering to each other during the test.
zh: 張老師怒視那兩個在考試中交頭接耳的學生。

en: Days of gloomy weather made everyone in the office feel tired and sleepy.
zh: 連日陰沉的天氣讓辦公室裡的每個人都覺得疲倦想睡。

en: Lisa looked gorgeous in her long blue dress at the graduation party.
zh: Lisa 在畢業派對上穿著藍色長禮服，看起來美極了。

en: Dr. Lin received a government grant to study how plastic affects sea life.
zh: 林博士獲得一筆政府補助金，研究塑膠對海洋生物的影響。

en: She works as a graphic designer, creating posters and book covers for local shops.
zh: 她是一名平面設計師，為當地商店設計海報和書籍封面。

en: Because the moon's gravity is weaker, people can jump much higher there than on Earth.
zh: 因為月球的重力較弱，人在那裡可以跳得比在地球上高得多。

en: In the story, the king's greed for gold finally brought him nothing but sadness.
zh: 在故事中，國王對黃金的貪婪最後只為他帶來悲傷。

en: Everyone in the village grieved for the old doctor who had cared for them for fifty years.
zh: 全村的人都為那位照顧他們五十年的老醫生感到悲傷。

en: Dad grilled some fish and corn in the yard for our Moon Festival barbecue.
zh: 爸爸在院子裡烤了一些魚和玉米，作為我們中秋節烤肉的菜色。

en: Doctors gave a grim warning that this year's flu season could be the worst in a decade.
zh: 醫生發出嚴峻的警告，今年的流感季可能是十年來最嚴重的一次。

en: Grip the handle firmly so that the heavy pot doesn't slip out of your hands.
zh: 緊握把手，以免沉重的鍋子從你手中滑落。

en: That movie earned a gross income of over two hundred million dollars in its first month.
zh: 那部電影上映第一個月的總收入超過兩億美元。

en: Teachers must follow the school's safety guidelines when taking students on field trips.
zh: 老師帶學生校外教學時，必須遵守學校的安全指導方針。

en: My gut told me something was wrong, so I decided not to open the strange email.
zh: 我的直覺告訴我有些不對勁，所以我決定不打開那封奇怪的電子郵件。

en: Cutting down forests destroys the natural habitat of many birds and monkeys.
zh: 砍伐森林會破壞許多鳥類和猴子的自然棲息地。

en: It took four workers to haul the old piano up the stairs to the third floor.
zh: 四名工人才把那架舊鋼琴沿著樓梯拖運到三樓。

en: Wet floors are a common hazard in school bathrooms, so students should walk carefully.
zh: 濕滑的地板是學校廁所常見的危險，所以學生應該小心行走。

en: As the only son, Henry became the heir to his father's large tea business.
zh: 身為獨子，Henry 成了父親龐大茶葉事業的繼承人。

en: A flood badly damaged the bridge; hence, all cars had to take another road.
zh: 洪水嚴重損壞了那座橋；因此，所有車輛都必須改道。

en: My mom grows herbs on our balcony and adds them to soups and salads.
zh: 媽媽在我們家陽台種香草，並把它們加進湯和沙拉裡。

en: This old street is part of the town's cultural heritage, so its buildings must be protected.
zh: 這條老街是小鎮文化遺產的一部分，所以街上的建築必須受到保護。

en: The highlight of our trip to Japan was watching the cherry blossoms in Kyoto.
zh: 我們日本之旅的精彩部分，是在京都賞櫻花。

en: Ice hockey is a fast and exciting sport that is very popular in Canada.
zh: 冰上曲棍球是一項快速又刺激的運動，在加拿大非常受歡迎。

en: Returning the lost wallet to its owner was an honorable thing for the boy to do.
zh: 把遺失的錢包還給失主，是這個男孩做的一件正直的事。

en: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page, and write your name above it.
zh: 在紙張中間畫一條水平線，然後在線的上方寫下你的名字。

en: During the teenage years, changes in hormones can affect both your body and your moods.
zh: 在青少年時期，荷爾蒙的變化會同時影響你的身體和情緒。

en: After hours of talking with the robbers, the police safely freed all the hostages.
zh: 經過數小時的談判，警方安全救出了所有人質。

en: The cat we found on the street was hostile at first, but it slowly learned to trust us.
zh: 我們在街上撿到的那隻貓起初充滿敵意，但牠慢慢學會信任我們。

en: Despite the hostility between the two neighbors, they worked together to clean up after the flood.
zh: 儘管兩位鄰居之間存有敵意，他們仍在水災後一起合作清理。

en: Housing prices in Taipei are so high that many young people cannot afford to buy an apartment.
zh: 台北的房價高到許多年輕人都買不起公寓。

en: Wolves howl at night to communicate with other members of their group.
zh: 狼會在夜裡嚎叫，與同伴互相溝通。

en: Scientists tested their hypothesis by growing the same plants under different colors of light.
zh: 科學家把同樣的植物種在不同顏色的光線下，以測試他們的假設。

en: Tap the camera icon at the bottom of the screen if you want to take a photo.
zh: 如果你想拍照，請點選螢幕下方的相機圖示。

en: In history class, we compared the different ideologies that shaped many countries in the last century.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們比較了上個世紀塑造許多國家的不同意識形態。

en: I felt like an idiot when I realized I had been wearing my shirt inside out all day.
zh: 當我發現自己整天都把襯衫穿反時，覺得自己像個白痴。

en: Mirrors on the walls create the illusion that the small coffee shop is much bigger.
zh: 牆上的鏡子製造出一種錯覺，讓這家小咖啡店看起來大得多。

en: Climbing Jade Mountain takes immense effort, but the view from the top is worth it.
zh: 攀登玉山需要付出極大的努力，但山頂的景色非常值得。

en: Most adults are immune to this virus because they caught it when they were children.
zh: 大多數成年人對這種病毒免疫，因為他們小時候就感染過了。

en: Starting next month, our school will implement a new rule that does not allow phones in class.
zh: 從下個月起，我們學校將實施一項上課禁用手機的新規定。

en: Scientists are still studying the long-term implications of climate change for farming.
zh: 科學家仍在研究氣候變遷對農業的長期影響。

en: I bought the expensive sweater on impulse and regretted it as soon as I got home.
zh: 我一時衝動買下那件昂貴的毛衣，一回到家就後悔了。

en: This store offers discounts as an incentive for customers to bring their own bags.
zh: 這家店提供折扣，作為鼓勵顧客自備購物袋的誘因。

en: Ms. Lee incorporates games and songs into her lessons to make learning English more fun.
zh: 李老師把遊戲和歌曲納入課程，讓學英文變得更有趣。

en: To find a topic quickly, look it up in the index at the back of the book.
zh: 想快速找到某個主題，就查書末的索引。

en: How can you be so indifferent to the problem of plastic waste in the ocean?
zh: 你怎麼能對海洋塑膠垃圾的問題如此漠不關心？

en: Taiwan's indigenous peoples have their own languages, music, and traditional festivals that are worth learning about.
zh: 台灣的原住民族擁有自己的語言、音樂和傳統祭典，值得我們認識。

en: For many students, a phone has become an indispensable tool for both study and fun.
zh: 對許多學生來說，手機已成為讀書和娛樂都不可或缺的工具。

en: On weekends, Lisa likes to indulge in a big bowl of ice cream after dinner.
zh: 週末時，Lisa 喜歡在晚餐後盡情享用一大碗冰淇淋。

en: Making mistakes is inevitable when you learn a new language, so don't be afraid to speak.
zh: 學新語言時犯錯是不可避免的，所以不要害怕開口說。

en: If you cough without covering your mouth, you might infect the people around you.
zh: 如果你咳嗽時不遮住嘴巴，可能會傳染給身邊的人。

en: Our teacher seemed to have infinite patience, answering the same question again and again.
zh: 我們老師似乎有無限的耐心，一次又一次回答同樣的問題。

en: After the earthquake, the government spent billions to repair roads, bridges, and other infrastructure.
zh: 地震過後，政府花了數十億元修復道路、橋梁和其他基礎建設。

en: Every sport has some inherent risks, so players should always wear the proper equipment.
zh: 每項運動都有一些固有的風險，所以選手應該隨時穿戴適當的裝備。

en: Amy inherited her mother's musical talent and began playing the piano at age four.
zh: Amy 繼承了媽媽的音樂天分，四歲就開始彈鋼琴。

en: Our class initiated a campaign to reduce the use of plastic in the school cafeteria.
zh: 我們班發起了一項活動，減少學校餐廳的塑膠使用量。

en: Mia took the initiative to clean the classroom without waiting for the teacher to ask.
zh: Mia 主動打掃教室，沒有等老師開口要求。

en: The nurse injected the medicine into the patient's arm and told him to rest for a while.
zh: 護理師把藥注射到病人的手臂裡，並叫他休息一會兒。

en: My little sister cried before getting a flu injection, but she said it didn't hurt much.
zh: 我妹妹打流感疫苗前哭了，但她說其實不太痛。

en: Our team scored three runs in the last inning and won the baseball game.
zh: 我們隊在最後一局拿下三分，贏得了棒球比賽。

en: Innovation in technology has completely changed the way people shop and communicate with each other.
zh: 科技上的創新徹底改變了人們購物和彼此溝通的方式。

en: Two students came up with an innovative way to turn food waste into food for plants.
zh: 兩名學生想出一個創新的方法，把廚餘變成植物的養分。

en: Hotel staff responded quickly to my inquiry about the price of a room with an ocean view.
zh: 飯店員工很快就回覆了我對海景房價格的詢問。

en: My friends said it was insane to go swimming in the sea while a typhoon was coming.
zh: 朋友們說颱風要來了還去海裡游泳簡直是瘋了。

en: Talking with elderly people can give us valuable insight into what life was like in the past.
zh: 和長輩聊天能讓我們對過去的生活有寶貴的洞察。

en: After the installation of air conditioners in every classroom, studying in summer became much more comfortable.
zh: 每間教室安裝冷氣之後，夏天讀書變得舒服多了。

en: She works as a researcher at an institute that studies ocean pollution and sea life.
zh: 她在一個研究海洋汙染與海洋生物的機構擔任研究員。

en: Universities and museums are important institutions for sharing knowledge with the public.
zh: 大學和博物館是與大眾分享知識的重要機構。

en: To our surprise, the glass vase remained intact after it fell from the table onto the floor.
zh: 令我們驚訝的是，那個玻璃花瓶從桌上掉到地上後竟然完好無缺。

en: The new system integrates bus and train schedules, so travelers can plan their trips easily.
zh: 新系統整合了公車和火車時刻表，讓旅客能輕鬆規劃行程。

en: Many schools are working on the integration of technology into daily teaching.
zh: 許多學校正致力於將科技整合到日常教學中。

en: A person of integrity always tells the truth, even when no one is watching.
zh: 正直的人即使沒有人在看，也總是說實話。

en: As the typhoon moved closer to Taiwan, the wind and rain intensified throughout the night.
zh: 隨著颱風逐漸接近台灣，風雨整夜不斷加劇。

en: His intent was to help, but his advice only made the situation more confusing.
zh: 他的本意是想幫忙，但他的建議只讓情況變得更混亂。

en: Teenagers often dislike their parents' interference in their choice of friends and clothes.
zh: 青少年通常不喜歡父母干涉他們交朋友和穿衣服的選擇。

en: We love the coffee shop's warm interior, which is decorated with plants and old photos.
zh: 我們很喜歡這家咖啡店溫馨的室內空間，裡面用植物和老照片裝飾。

en: Each student had a different interpretation of the poem, which led to an interesting discussion.
zh: 每位學生對這首詩都有不同的詮釋，因而引發了一場有趣的討論。

en: Buses on this route run at intervals of fifteen minutes during rush hour.
zh: 尖峰時段，這條路線的公車每隔十五分鐘一班。

en: Thanks to early intervention by doctors, the baby fully recovered from the serious illness.
zh: 多虧醫生及早介入治療，寶寶從重病中完全康復了。

en: Investigators are still trying to find out what caused the fire at the factory.
zh: 調查員仍在設法查明工廠火災的起因。

en: It was pure irony that the speaker giving a talk on time management arrived thirty minutes late.
zh: 諷刺的是，那位主講時間管理的講者竟然遲到了三十分鐘。

en: Hannah wants to study journalism because she loves writing and asking questions about the world.
zh: Hannah 想讀新聞系，因為她熱愛寫作，也喜歡對世界提出問題。

en: A journalist interviewed several students about their opinions on the new school uniforms.
zh: 一位記者訪問了幾名學生對新校服的看法。

en: A fair judicial system should treat everyone equally, whether they are rich or poor.
zh: 公正的司法制度應該平等對待每個人，無論貧富。

en: Mom placed a large jug of cold lemon tea on the table for our guests.
zh: 媽媽在桌上放了一大壺冰檸檬茶招待客人。

en: After two days of careful discussion, the jury finally reached its decision.
zh: 經過兩天的審慎討論，陪審團終於做出了決定。

en: How can you justify spending so much money on a pair of shoes you'll wear only once?
zh: 你怎麼能替自己花那麼多錢買一雙只會穿一次的鞋子找理由？

en: In Taiwan, cases involving people under eighteen are usually handled by a juvenile court.
zh: 在台灣，涉及未滿十八歲者的案件通常由少年法庭處理。

en: In the mystery novel, a rich businessman's daughter is kidnapped, and a clever detective must find her.
zh: 在這本推理小說中，一位富商的女兒遭到綁架，一名聰明的偵探必須找到她。

en: Our landlord agreed to fix the broken air conditioner before the summer heat arrives.
zh: 我們的房東同意在夏季高溫來臨前修好壞掉的冷氣。

en: Doctors can now use lasers to treat some eye problems without making large cuts.
zh: 醫生現在可以用雷射治療某些眼睛問題，而不必開很大的刀口。

en: Lawmakers are discussing a new law to protect workers from working too many hours.
zh: 立法者正在討論一項保護勞工免於工時過長的新法。

en: The family brought a lawsuit against the company after its heater caused a fire in their home.
zh: 這家人在該公司的暖爐引發家中火災後，對公司提起訴訟。

en: When a cold front arrives, remember to wear several layers of clothing to stay warm.
zh: 冷鋒來襲時，記得多穿幾層衣服保暖。

en: Our school basketball team joined a local league and plays a game against another school every weekend.
zh: 我們學校的籃球隊加入了當地的聯盟，每個週末都和另一所學校比賽。

en: The old library is a legacy of the town's first mayor, who believed every child deserved free books.
zh: 這座老圖書館是該鎮第一任鎮長留下的遺產，他相信每個孩子都應該有免費的書可讀。

en: Many fans traveled across the country to see the legendary singer perform her final concert.
zh: 許多歌迷橫越全國，只為了看這位傳奇歌手演出她的最後一場演唱會。

en: New legislation now requires all restaurants in the city to reduce their use of plastic straws.
zh: 新的法律現在要求市內所有餐廳減少塑膠吸管的使用。

en: In our social studies class, we learned how the legislative branch makes and changes the nation's laws.
zh: 在公民課上，我們學到立法部門如何制定和修改國家的法律。

en: Feeling tired after studying all night is a legitimate reason to take a short break.
zh: 熬夜讀書後感到疲倦，是休息一下的正當理由。

en: Write down your teacher's instructions carefully lest you forget them before the test next week.
zh: 仔細寫下老師的指示，以免在下週考試前就忘了。

en: Some parents see a large dog as a liability because it may need costly care and training.
zh: 有些父母把大型犬視為一種負擔，因為牠可能需要昂貴的照顧和訓練。

en: Regular exercise can greatly reduce the likelihood of developing heart disease later in life.
zh: 規律運動可以大幅降低日後罹患心臟病的可能性。

en: Amy always cleans her desk before leaving school, and her best friend does likewise every afternoon.
zh: Amy 放學前總會整理書桌，她最好的朋友每天下午也同樣這麼做。

en: Runners in the charity event completed three loops around the lake before reaching the finish line.
zh: 慈善活動中的跑者繞湖跑了三圈才抵達終點線。

en: After the long flight, we waited in the airport lounge and enjoyed some tea and snacks.
zh: 長途飛行後，我們在機場休息室等候，享用了一些茶和點心。

en: Grandma felt a small lump in her neck, so she went to see a doctor right away.
zh: 奶奶摸到脖子上有個小腫塊，所以她立刻去看醫生。

en: Music that was once considered strange has slowly moved into the mainstream over the past decade.
zh: 曾經被認為奇怪的音樂，在過去十年中慢慢進入了主流。

en: The school pool will be closed all week for maintenance, so swimming lessons are canceled.
zh: 學校游泳池整週都會因維修而關閉，所以游泳課取消了。

en: Whales are mammals, so they must come up to the surface of the ocean to breathe air.
zh: 鯨魚是哺乳動物，所以牠們必須浮到海面上呼吸空氣。

en: The new mayor won the election easily and believed she had a clear mandate to improve public transportation.
zh: 新市長輕鬆贏得選舉，並認為自己獲得了改善大眾運輸的明確授權。

en: Lisa's love of nature began to manifest itself in her colorful paintings of birds and flowers.
zh: Lisa 對大自然的熱愛開始在她那些鳥與花的彩色畫作中顯現出來。

en: Some online advertisements try to manipulate young people into buying things they don't really need.
zh: 有些網路廣告試圖操縱年輕人去買他們其實不需要的東西。

en: The rich family lived in a huge mansion with twenty bedrooms and a beautiful garden.
zh: 那個富有的家庭住在一棟有二十間臥室和美麗花園的豪宅裡。

en: Plastic waste in the sea is a serious threat to marine animals such as sea turtles.
zh: 海中的塑膠垃圾對海龜等海洋動物是嚴重的威脅。

en: In the past, many people thought that strength was a masculine quality, but that idea is changing.
zh: 過去許多人認為力量是男性的特質，但這種觀念正在改變。

en: After a long day of hiking, Dad enjoyed a relaxing foot massage at a shop near the hotel.
zh: 健行了一整天之後，爸爸在飯店附近的店裡享受了放鬆的腳底按摩。

en: The typhoon caused massive damage, knocking down thousands of trees across the eastern coast.
zh: 颱風造成巨大的損害，東部沿海有數千棵樹被吹倒。

en: Many art lovers believe that the Mona Lisa is the greatest masterpiece in the history of painting.
zh: 許多藝術愛好者相信《蒙娜麗莎》是繪畫史上最偉大的傑作。

en: My back hurt every morning until my parents bought me a new, firmer mattress for my bed.
zh: 我每天早上都背痛，直到爸媽幫我的床買了一張較硬的新床墊。

en: The new library won't open until next year; in the meantime, students can borrow books online.
zh: 新圖書館要到明年才會開放；在此期間，學生可以在網路上借書。

en: Scientists are studying the mechanism that allows birds to find their way home over long distances.
zh: 科學家正在研究讓鳥類能夠長途飛行仍找到回家路的機制。

en: The doctor told Amy to take her medication twice a day after meals for one week.
zh: 醫生告訴 Amy 一週內每天飯後服藥兩次。

en: Ms. Lin became my mentor in high school and taught me how to plan my study time.
zh: 林老師成了我高中時的導師，教我如何規劃讀書時間。

en: The two small villages decided to merge into one town in order to share schools and hospitals.
zh: 兩個小村莊決定合併成一個城鎮，以便共享學校和醫院。

en: When the poet calls life "a long road," she is using a metaphor to describe our journey.
zh: 當詩人把人生稱為「一條漫長的路」時，她是用隱喻來描述我們的旅程。

en: Housing prices in the metropolitan area have risen so fast that many young workers move to nearby towns.
zh: 大都會地區的房價上漲得太快，許多年輕上班族因此搬到附近的城鎮。

en: In the midst of the busy night market, we found a quiet shop that sold fresh fruit tea.
zh: 在熱鬧的夜市之中，我們發現一家賣新鮮水果茶的安靜小店。

en: Every winter, the migration of thousands of birds to the wetlands attracts many visitors.
zh: 每年冬天，數千隻鳥遷徙到濕地，吸引了許多遊客。

en: Passing the driving test was an important milestone for my brother on his eighteenth birthday.
zh: 通過駕照考試是我哥哥十八歲生日時的重要里程碑。

en: Ben spent the summer building a miniature model of Taipei 101 out of wood and paper.
zh: Ben 花了整個暑假用木頭和紙做了一座台北 101 的縮小模型。

en: The new phone requires minimal effort to set up, so even my grandparents can use it easily.
zh: 這支新手機只需最少的力氣就能設定好，所以連我的祖父母都能輕鬆使用。

en: To minimize waste, our class brings our own cups and chopsticks to every school event.
zh: 為了把浪費減到最少，我們班每次學校活動都自備杯子和筷子。

en: Lisa added a few fresh mint leaves to her lemon tea to make it taste cooler.
zh: Lisa 在檸檬茶裡加了幾片新鮮薄荷葉，讓它喝起來更清涼。

en: In the nineteenth century, a missionary from Canada built schools and a hospital in northern Taiwan.
zh: 十九世紀時，一位來自加拿大的傳教士在台灣北部興建了學校和醫院。

en: My little brother always moans about doing homework, but he finishes it quickly in the end.
zh: 我弟弟總是抱怨寫功課，但最後都很快就寫完了。

en: Our teacher gave us a mock exam last week so we could practice for the real test.
zh: 老師上週給我們一場模擬考，讓我們為正式考試做練習。

en: Please put your phones in silent mode before the concert begins so that no one is disturbed.
zh: 音樂會開始前請把手機調成靜音模式，以免打擾到任何人。

en: After reading the comments from her classmates, Mia decided to modify the ending of her short story.
zh: 看完同學的意見後，Mia 決定修改她短篇故事的結局。

en: A water molecule is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
zh: 一個水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。

en: When one company has a monopoly on a product, it can raise prices without losing customers.
zh: 當一家公司壟斷某項產品時，就能抬高價格而不流失顧客。

en: The story raises important questions about morality, such as whether it is ever right to tell a lie.
zh: 這個故事提出了關於道德的重要問題，例如說謊是否有正當的時候。

en: Better health care has greatly lowered the infant mortality rate in many developing countries.
zh: 更好的醫療照護已大幅降低許多開發中國家的嬰兒死亡率。

en: My parents took out a mortgage to buy our apartment and will pay it back over twenty years.
zh: 我爸媽申請了房貸來買我們的公寓，並將在二十年內還清。

en: The police are still trying to find out the motive behind the strange fire at the factory.
zh: 警方仍在試圖找出工廠那場奇怪火災背後的動機。

en: As the exam date got closer, the pressure on the students began to mount day by day.
zh: 隨著考試日期越來越近，學生的壓力一天天增加。

en: When the teacher asked him a question, Tom just mumbled an answer that nobody could hear clearly.
zh: 老師問他問題時，Tom 只是含糊地喃喃說了一個沒人聽得清楚的答案。

en: The municipal government plans to build more bike lanes and public parks in the city center.
zh: 市政府計畫在市中心興建更多自行車道和公園。

en: The swimmer's strong, muscular arms helped her pull through the water at amazing speed.
zh: 這位泳者強壯結實的手臂幫助她以驚人的速度划水前進。

en: Dad likes to put a little mustard on his hot dog, but I prefer mine with only ketchup.
zh: 爸爸喜歡在熱狗上加一點芥末，但我比較喜歡只加番茄醬。

en: It is a myth that eating carrots will give you perfect eyesight in the dark.
zh: 吃紅蘿蔔就能讓你在黑暗中擁有完美視力，這是一種迷思。

en: It was naive of me to believe that I could finish the whole project in one night.
zh: 我以為能在一個晚上完成整個專題，真是太天真了。

en: The novel's narrative moves back and forth between the grandmother's childhood and the present day.
zh: 這本小說的敘事在祖母的童年和現代之間來回切換。

en: The milk had gone bad and left a nasty smell in the kitchen for the whole day.
zh: 牛奶壞掉了，在廚房裡留下了一整天令人作噁的臭味。

en: After weeks of negotiation, the two companies finally agreed on a fair price for the land.
zh: 經過數週的談判，兩家公司終於就這塊土地的公平價格達成協議。

en: When my two best friends argued, I tried to stay neutral and listen to both sides.
zh: 當我兩個最好的朋友吵架時，我試著保持中立，聽聽雙方的說法。

en: Our class decided to nominate Lisa for student council because she is fair and hardworking.
zh: 我們班決定提名 Lisa 參選學生會，因為她公正又勤奮。

en: Her nomination for the best young writer award surprised everyone, including her own family.
zh: 她獲得最佳青年作家獎的提名，讓所有人都很驚訝，包括她自己的家人。

en: Each nominee for class leader gave a short speech explaining what she would do for the class.
zh: 每位班長被提名人都發表了簡短演說，說明她會為班上做些什麼。

en: My aunt works for a nonprofit group that collects used books for children in poor areas.
zh: 我阿姨在一個非營利團體工作，該團體為貧困地區的孩子募集二手書。

en: In some cultures, it is the norm for young adults to live with their parents until they marry.
zh: 在某些文化中，年輕人結婚前和父母同住是常態。

en: After a month of daily practice, there was a noticeable improvement in Lisa's piano playing.
zh: 經過一個月的每日練習，Lisa 的鋼琴彈奏有了顯著的進步。

en: The school will notify all parents by text message if classes are canceled because of a typhoon.
zh: 如果因颱風停課，學校會用簡訊通知所有家長。

en: Many people hold the notion that success depends only on talent, but hard work matters just as much.
zh: 許多人抱持成功只取決於天分的想法，但努力同樣重要。

en: I looked everywhere for my house key, but it was nowhere to be found.
zh: 我到處找我家的鑰匙，但哪裡都找不到。

en: Green vegetables are rich in nutrients that help keep our bones and skin healthy.
zh: 綠色蔬菜富含營養素，有助於保持骨骼和皮膚健康。

en: Good nutrition is important for teenagers, whose bodies are still growing and developing.
zh: 良好的營養對青少年很重要，因為他們的身體仍在成長發育。

en: Students have an obligation to follow school rules, just as teachers have a duty to treat them fairly.
zh: 學生有遵守校規的義務，正如老師有公平對待學生的責任。

en: Thick clouds began to obscure the moon, and soon the whole sky turned dark.
zh: 厚厚的雲層開始遮蔽月亮，很快整片天空都暗了下來。

en: A careful observer will notice that many birds in the park return to the same tree every evening.
zh: 細心的觀察者會注意到，公園裡許多鳥每天傍晚都會回到同一棵樹上。

en: Our team was much smaller than theirs, but against all odds, we won the championship.
zh: 我們隊的人數比他們少很多，但我們克服了極低的勝算，贏得了冠軍。

en: At the temple, visitors place offerings of fruit and flowers on the table to show respect.
zh: 在廟裡，參拜者把水果和鮮花等供品放在桌上以示敬意。

en: Mom makes a simple salad with tomatoes, cheese, and a little olive oil.
zh: 媽媽用番茄、起司和一點橄欖油做了一份簡單的沙拉。

en: The new train line will become operational next spring, making it easier for students to get to school.
zh: 新鐵路線將在明年春天開始營運，讓學生上學更方便。

en: In the final match, Amy shook hands with her opponent and thanked her for a great game.
zh: 在決賽中，Amy 和她的對手握手，感謝她帶來一場精彩的比賽。

en: The plan to cut down the old trees met strong opposition from local people and students.
zh: 砍伐老樹的計畫遭到當地居民和學生的強烈反對。

en: Instead of taking the bus, many students opt to ride their bikes to school on sunny days.
zh: 晴天時，許多學生選擇騎腳踏車上學，而不搭公車。

en: Despite failing the first test, Ben faced the next one with optimism and studied even harder.
zh: 儘管第一次考試沒及格，Ben 仍以樂觀的態度面對下一次考試，而且更加用功。

en: The weekend art class is optional, but many students choose to join because it is fun.
zh: 週末美術課是可選擇參加的，但很多學生都選擇參加，因為很有趣。

en: We spent Saturday morning picking fresh apples in an orchard in the mountains.
zh: 我們星期六早上在山上的果園裡採新鮮蘋果。

en: Tiny organisms in the ocean produce much of the oxygen that we breathe every day.
zh: 海洋中的微小生物產生了我們每天呼吸的大部分氧氣。

en: The judges praised the student film for its originality and its creative use of music.
zh: 評審稱讚這部學生電影的獨創性以及對音樂的創意運用。

en: Lisa chose a simple blue outfit for the school dance and looked elegant in it.
zh: Lisa 為學校舞會挑了一套簡單的藍色服裝，穿起來很優雅。

en: There was no outlet near my seat, so I couldn't charge my laptop during the long train ride.
zh: 我座位附近沒有插座，所以搭長途火車時沒辦法幫筆電充電。

en: The factory doubled its output this year by using new machines and better training.
zh: 這家工廠今年藉由使用新機器和更好的訓練，使產量翻倍。

en: As a new student, Mia felt like an outsider at first, but she soon made many friends.
zh: 身為轉學生，Mia 起初覺得自己像個局外人，但她很快就交到許多朋友。

en: Some parts of the trip were tiring, but overall, it was our best family vacation ever.
zh: 旅程中有些部分很累人，但整體來說，那是我們家最棒的一次假期。

en: A group of wild geese flew overhead as we walked along the river at sunset.
zh: 日落時我們沿著河邊散步，一群野雁從頭頂上飛過。

en: Ms. Chen will oversee the science fair and make sure that every project follows the safety rules.
zh: 陳老師將監督科展，確保每個作品都遵守安全規則。

en: In the last hundred meters, the young runner managed to overtake the leader and win the race.
zh: 在最後一百公尺，這位年輕跑者成功超越了領先者，贏得比賽。

en: New evidence led the court to overturn its earlier decision, and the man was finally set free.
zh: 新證據讓法院推翻了先前的判決，那名男子終於獲得自由。

en: Feeling overwhelmed by all her homework, Amy made a list and finished the tasks one by one.
zh: Amy 被所有作業壓得不知所措，於是列了一張清單，逐一完成每項任務。

en: The road runs parallel to the river, so drivers can enjoy the view of the water.
zh: 這條路和河流平行，所以駕駛人可以欣賞水景。

en: Each participant in the study was asked to keep a record of how many hours they slept.
zh: 研究中的每位參與者都被要求記錄自己睡了幾個小時。

en: Scientists use powerful machines to study the tiny particles that make up all matter.
zh: 科學家使用強大的機器來研究構成所有物質的微小粒子。

en: Lisa was late for school partly because of the heavy rain and partly because she got up late.
zh: Lisa 上學遲到，部分是因為大雨，部分是因為她太晚起床。

en: Our history teacher is so passionate about the past that her lessons never feel boring.
zh: 我們的歷史老師對過去的事充滿熱情，所以她的課從不讓人覺得無聊。

en: The bakery near our school sells delicious pastries, and my favorite is the one with fresh strawberries.
zh: 我們學校附近的麵包店賣美味的糕點，我最喜歡的是加了新鮮草莓的那一款。

en: Grandma sewed a colorful patch over the hole in my jeans, and now they look even cooler.
zh: 奶奶在我牛仔褲的破洞上縫了一塊彩色補丁，現在看起來更酷了。

en: The young inventor applied for a patent to protect her new design for a folding bike.
zh: 這位年輕發明家為她的新折疊腳踏車設計申請了專利，以保護她的設計。

en: His excuse for not doing his homework was so pathetic that the whole class laughed.
zh: 他沒寫作業的藉口太可悲了，全班都笑了出來。

en: Police officers patrol the night market every evening to keep visitors safe.
zh: 警察每天晚上在夜市巡邏，以維護遊客的安全。

en: The museum thanked its patrons, whose generous gifts helped pay for the new art hall.
zh: 博物館感謝它的贊助者，他們慷慨的捐贈幫助支付了新藝術館的費用。

en: In the old days, most peasants worked long hours in the fields but owned very little land.
zh: 在過去，大多數農民在田裡長時間工作，卻只擁有很少的土地。

en: When riding down a steep hill, press the brake pedal gently instead of stopping suddenly.
zh: 騎下陡坡時，要輕輕踩煞車踏板，而不是突然停下。

en: Drivers must stop and let pedestrians cross the street safely at the crosswalk.
zh: 駕駛人必須停車，讓行人在斑馬線上安全過馬路。

en: Sunlight could not penetrate the thick forest, so it was dark and cool under the trees.
zh: 陽光無法穿透茂密的森林，所以樹下又暗又涼。

en: After working for forty years, my grandfather now lives on a small government pension.
zh: 工作了四十年之後，我祖父現在靠一筆微薄的政府退休金生活。

en: Many teenagers perceive their parents' advice as pressure, even when it is meant to help.
zh: 許多青少年把父母的建議視為壓力，即使那些建議是出於好意。

en: Social media can change our perception of beauty and make us feel bad about our looks.
zh: 社群媒體可能改變我們對美的看法，讓我們對自己的外表感到不滿意。

en: The street performer played the guitar and sang, and a large crowd gathered around him.
zh: 那位街頭表演者彈吉他唱歌，一大群人聚集在他身邊。

en: If your cough persists for more than two weeks, you should see a doctor.
zh: 如果你咳嗽持續超過兩週，就應該去看醫生。

en: Only hospital personnel are allowed to enter this area, so visitors must wait outside.
zh: 只有醫院人員可以進入這個區域，所以訪客必須在外面等候。

en: Reading novels from other cultures helps us see the world from a different perspective.
zh: 閱讀其他文化的小說，能幫助我們從不同的觀點看世界。

en: A little pessimism can be useful, but too much of it may stop you from trying new things.
zh: 一點點悲觀也許有用，但太多悲觀可能會讓你不敢嘗試新事物。

en: More than two thousand students signed a petition asking the school to keep the library open later.
zh: 超過兩千名學生簽署請願書，要求學校延長圖書館開放時間。

en: Don't let petty fights over who sits where ruin a friendship that has lasted for years.
zh: 別讓為了誰坐哪裡這種瑣碎的爭執，毀了一段維持多年的友誼。

en: The first phase of the project is collecting data, and the second is writing the report.
zh: 這個專題的第一階段是蒐集資料，第二階段是撰寫報告。

en: The photographic exhibition shows how Taipei has changed over the past hundred years.
zh: 這場攝影展呈現台北在過去一百年間的變化。

en: My dad drives a pickup, so he often helps our neighbors move heavy furniture.
zh: 我爸爸開一輛小貨車，所以他常幫鄰居搬重家具。

en: We walked to the end of the pier to watch the fishing boats come back at sunset.
zh: 我們走到碼頭的盡頭，看漁船在日落時返航。

en: Four tall stone pillars hold up the roof of the old temple in the center of town.
zh: 四根高大的石柱撐起了鎮中心那座老廟的屋頂。

en: Workers are repairing an oil pipeline that runs under the sea between the two islands.
zh: 工人正在修理一條鋪設在兩座島嶼之間海底的石油管線。

en: In the story, a group of pirates sailed the seas in search of hidden gold.
zh: 在這個故事裡，一群海盜航行四海，尋找藏起來的黃金。

en: Our team's pitcher threw the ball so fast that the batter couldn't even see it.
zh: 我們隊的投手球投得太快，打擊者甚至看不見球。

en: Before the school year begins, new students take a placement test to decide which English class they join.
zh: 學年開始前，新生要參加分班測驗，以決定他們上哪一個英文班。

en: Ignoring the child's plea for help, the busy crowd kept walking until a kind old woman stopped.
zh: 忙碌的人群不理會那孩子的求救，一直往前走，直到一位好心的老婦人停下腳步。

en: Amy pleaded with her parents to let her join the summer art camp in Tainan.
zh: Amy 懇求父母讓她參加在台南舉辦的暑期美術營。

en: All club members made a pledge to pick up trash on the beach once a month.
zh: 社團所有成員都立下誓言，每個月去海灘撿一次垃圾。

en: On a hot afternoon, the kids took a plunge into the cool river to escape the heat.
zh: 在炎熱的午後，孩子們跳進清涼的河裡消暑。

en: In English, most words form their plural by adding an "s," but "child" becomes "children."
zh: 在英文中，大多數字的複數是加上「s」，但「child」會變成「children」。

en: Her poetic description of the morning sea made us feel as if we were standing on the beach.
zh: 她對清晨海洋充滿詩意的描寫，讓我們彷彿站在沙灘上。

en: My little brother kept poking me with his pencil while I was trying to study.
zh: 我在努力讀書時，弟弟一直用鉛筆戳我。

en: On summer evenings, my grandparents like to sit on the porch and watch the stars.
zh: 夏天晚上，我的祖父母喜歡坐在門廊上看星星。

en: To apply for the art program, students must hand in a portfolio of their best drawings and paintings.
zh: 申請美術課程時，學生必須繳交一份收錄他們最佳素描和畫作的作品集。

en: Doctors and other health care practitioners must keep learning about new treatments throughout their careers.
zh: 醫師和其他醫療從業人員在整個職業生涯中都必須持續學習新的療法。

en: As a precaution, we carried extra water and a map in case we got lost on the mountain.
zh: 為了預防萬一，我們多帶了水和地圖，以防在山上迷路。

en: Sharks are top predators in the ocean, but they are also in danger because of overfishing.
zh: 鯊魚是海洋中的頂級掠食者，但牠們也因過度捕撈而面臨危機。

en: When it comes to music, my preference is for quiet songs that help me relax.
zh: 說到音樂，我偏好能幫助我放鬆的安靜歌曲。

en: We should never judge people by their looks, because prejudice often comes from a lack of understanding.
zh: 我們永遠不該以貌取人，因為偏見往往來自缺乏了解。
