en: Based on the preliminary results of the survey, most students prefer to start school later.
zh: 根據調查的初步結果，大多數學生希望晚一點上學。

en: It is premature to celebrate our victory, because the second half of the game hasn't even started.
zh: 現在慶祝勝利還太早，因為下半場比賽都還沒開始。

en: Japan is one of the premier places in Asia for tourists, famous for its food and hot springs.
zh: 日本是亞洲首屈一指的旅遊勝地之一，以美食和溫泉聞名。

en: His whole idea rests on the premise that everyone wants to get rich, which is simply not true.
zh: 他的整個想法建立在每個人都想致富的前提上，但這並不正確。

en: Customers who want their packages delivered the next day must pay a premium for fast shipping.
zh: 想讓包裹隔天送達的顧客，必須為快速運送支付額外費用。

en: The doctor prescribed some medicine for my cough and told me to drink plenty of warm water.
zh: 醫生為我的咳嗽開了一些藥，並叫我多喝溫水。

en: You can't buy this kind of medicine without a prescription from your doctor.
zh: 沒有醫生的處方，你不能買這種藥。

en: During her presidency of the student council, Lisa organized many events to help the local community.
zh: Lisa 擔任學生會會長期間，舉辦了許多幫助當地社區的活動。

en: In history class, we compared the speeches given by two candidates during a presidential election in the 1960s.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們比較了 1960 年代一場總統選舉中兩位候選人的演說。

en: Since the lights are off and the door is locked, the shop is presumably closed for the holiday.
zh: 既然燈關了、門也鎖著，這家店大概是因為放假而沒開。

en: Because Ben wasn't at practice, the coach presumed that he was sick and called his mother.
zh: 因為 Ben 沒來練習，教練推測他生病了，就打電話給他媽媽。

en: In the end, common sense prevailed, and the class agreed to share the work fairly.
zh: 最後常理占了上風，全班同意公平分擔工作。

en: Owls hunt at night, using their sharp eyes and ears to find their prey in the dark.
zh: 貓頭鷹在夜間狩獵，利用敏銳的眼睛和耳朵在黑暗中尋找獵物。

en: No prior experience is needed to join the cooking club, because the teacher will start with the basics.
zh: 參加烹飪社不需要先前的經驗，因為老師會從基礎教起。

en: At the opening event, the mayor proclaimed the start of the city's first international book fair.
zh: 在開幕活動上，市長宣告該市首屆國際書展正式開始。

en: Studies show that short breaks during work can improve productivity and help people focus better.
zh: 研究顯示，工作中短暫休息可以提高生產力，並幫助人們更專心。

en: Before the interview, Mia read the company's profile on its website to learn about its history.
zh: 面試前，Mia 在公司網站上閱讀了公司的簡介，以了解它的歷史。

en: Reading that book had a profound effect on Lisa, and she decided to become a nurse.
zh: 閱讀那本書對 Lisa 產生了深刻的影響，她決定成為一名護理師。

en: With progressive training, runners slowly increase the distance they run each week to avoid injury.
zh: 透過漸進式訓練，跑者每週慢慢增加跑步距離，以避免受傷。

en: Many schools now prohibit the use of mobile phones during class to help students concentrate.
zh: 許多學校現在禁止在上課時使用手機，以幫助學生專心。

en: A recent projection shows that the number of elderly people in Taiwan will keep rising.
zh: 一項最新的預測顯示，台灣的老年人口將持續增加。

en: Eating well and exercising regularly can help prolong your life and keep your mind sharp.
zh: 飲食均衡和規律運動有助於延長壽命，並保持頭腦敏銳。

en: Young children are prone to catching colds because their bodies are still building up defenses.
zh: 幼童容易感冒，因為他們的身體仍在建立防禦力。

en: In history class, we studied how wartime propaganda posters were used to shape public opinion.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們研究了戰時的宣傳海報如何被用來影響公眾輿論。

en: In ancient stories, a prophet was believed to receive messages from the gods about the future.
zh: 在古老的故事中，人們相信先知能從神那裡得到關於未來的訊息。

en: A large proportion of the students in our school take the bus or train to school.
zh: 我們學校有很大比例的學生搭公車或火車上學。

en: In the TV drama we watched, the prosecution presented new evidence that changed the judge's mind.
zh: 在我們看的電視劇中，檢方提出了新證據，改變了法官的想法。

en: With good grades and strong English skills, Amy has excellent prospects of getting into a top university.
zh: 憑著好成績和優秀的英文能力，Amy 很有希望進入頂尖大學。

en: Canada is divided into ten provinces, and each one has its own local government.
zh: 加拿大分為十個省，每個省都有自己的地方政府。

en: The government made provisions for clean water and food after the earthquake hit the area.
zh: 地震襲擊該地區後，政府提供了乾淨的水和食物。

en: His rude comment provoked an angry reaction from the audience, and he quickly said sorry.
zh: 他無禮的言論激怒了觀眾，於是他很快就道了歉。

en: After running up the stairs, Amy checked her pulse and found that her heart was beating very fast.
zh: 跑上樓梯後，Amy 量了一下脈搏，發現心跳得非常快。

en: You can return any purchase within seven days if you keep the receipt.
zh: 只要保留收據，任何購買的商品都可以在七天內退貨。

en: People in ancient Egypt built the pyramids more than four thousand years ago without modern machines.
zh: 古埃及人在四千多年前，沒有現代機器的情況下建造了金字塔。

en: To qualify for the national swimming team, students must finish the race within a set time.
zh: 學生必須在規定時間內游完比賽，才有資格進入國家游泳隊。

en: Her quest for knowledge led her to read every science book in the school library.
zh: 她對知識的追求，讓她讀遍了學校圖書館裡的每一本科學書。

en: Please fill out this short questionnaire about your sleeping habits and return it to your teacher.
zh: 請填寫這份關於睡眠習慣的簡短問卷，並交給你的老師。

en: As the little girl stood in the cold wind without a coat, her lips began to quiver.
zh: 那個小女孩沒穿外套站在寒風中，嘴唇開始顫抖。

en: Each fishing boat has a quota that limits how many fish it can catch in a year.
zh: 每艘漁船都有配額，限制它一年能捕多少魚。

en: Our class read a novel about a girl who fought against racism in her school in the 1950s.
zh: 我們班讀了一本小說，講述一個女孩在 1950 年代對抗學校裡種族歧視的故事。

en: Please put your wet umbrellas on the rack by the door before entering the classroom.
zh: 進教室前，請把濕雨傘放在門邊的架子上。

en: Too much exposure to the sun's radiation can damage your skin, so wear sunscreen at the beach.
zh: 過度暴露在陽光的輻射下會傷害皮膚，所以去海邊要擦防曬乳。

en: The new principal made radical changes, such as letting students design their own school uniforms.
zh: 新校長做了根本性的改變，例如讓學生自己設計校服。

en: After weeks of walking through the mountains, the travelers' clothes were dirty and ragged.
zh: 在山中走了好幾個星期後，旅人們的衣服又髒又破爛。

en: In history class, we read about a surprise raid on a small fort during the war.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們讀到戰爭期間一次對小型堡壘的突襲。

en: Hold on to the rail when you walk down the stairs, especially when the steps are wet.
zh: 下樓梯時要抓緊欄杆，尤其是在階梯潮濕的時候。

en: Thousands of people joined a peaceful rally in the park to call for cleaner air.
zh: 數千人參加了公園裡的一場和平集會，呼籲改善空氣品質。

en: My uncle owns a large ranch in Australia where he raises sheep and horses.
zh: 我叔叔在澳洲擁有一座大牧場，在那裡養羊和馬。

en: Our teacher picked students in random order, so nobody knew who would answer next.
zh: 老師隨機點學生，所以沒人知道下一個要回答的是誰。

en: In our class, the ratio of girls to boys is about two to one.
zh: 在我們班上，女生和男生的比例大約是二比一。

en: Instead of shouting, try to have a peaceful and rational discussion when you disagree with your parents.
zh: 和父母意見不合時，與其大吼大叫，不如試著冷靜理性地討論。

en: Strong winds rattled the windows all night, and I could hardly fall asleep.
zh: 強風整晚把窗戶吹得嘎嘎作響，我幾乎睡不著。

en: Famous for its realism, the painting shows every detail of the farmers' tired faces.
zh: 這幅畫以寫實聞名，描繪出農民疲憊面容的每個細節。

en: For many teens, fantasy novels open the door to a magical realm full of dragons and wizards.
zh: 對許多青少年來說，奇幻小說開啟了一扇通往充滿龍與巫師的魔法王國的大門。

en: Students who sit in the rear of the classroom sometimes have trouble seeing the board.
zh: 坐在教室後面的學生有時候會看不清楚黑板。

en: Before the big exam, my mother reassured me that a single test would not decide my whole future.
zh: 大考前，媽媽安慰我說，一次考試不會決定我的整個未來。

en: In history class, we learned about a rebellion in which farmers fought against heavy taxes.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到一場農民反抗沉重稅收的叛亂。

en: During the recession, many companies stopped hiring, and it became hard for young people to find jobs.
zh: 在經濟衰退期間，許多公司停止招人，年輕人很難找到工作。

en: Each recipient of the scholarship will receive money to help pay for college.
zh: 每位獎學金的獲得者都會得到一筆錢，用來支付大學學費。

en: For the school contest, Amy chose to recite a famous Chinese poem in front of the whole school.
zh: 在學校比賽中，Amy 選擇在全校面前朗誦一首著名的中國古詩。

en: Can you recommend a good book for someone who has just started reading English novels?
zh: 你能推薦一本適合剛開始讀英文小說的人看的好書嗎？

en: Mr. Wang wrote a strong letter of recommendation to help Lisa get into her dream university.
zh: 王老師寫了一封很有力的推薦信，幫助 Lisa 進入她夢想中的大學。

en: Our drama club is trying to recruit new members who are interested in acting or stage design.
zh: 我們的戲劇社正在招募對表演或舞台設計有興趣的新成員。

en: During the heavy storm, the school gym became a refuge for families who had to leave their homes.
zh: 在大暴雨期間，學校體育館成為那些被迫離家的家庭的避難所。

en: Our coach makes us practice outdoors every afternoon, regardless of the weather or the temperature.
zh: 不管天氣或氣溫如何，教練每天下午都要我們在戶外練習。

en: In world history, we learned how the old regime lost power after the people demanded change.
zh: 在世界史課上，我們學到舊政權如何在人民要求改變後失去權力。

en: We had our final rehearsal on the stage the night before the school play.
zh: 在校園戲劇演出的前一晚，我們在舞台上進行最後一次排練。

en: Doing practice questions every day will reinforce what you have learned in class.
zh: 每天做練習題，可以加強你在課堂上學到的東西。

en: Lisa set a reminder on her phone so that she would not forget her friend's birthday.
zh: Lisa 在手機上設了提醒，以免忘記朋友的生日。

en: Volunteers spent the whole morning on the removal of trash from the beach after the typhoon.
zh: 颱風過後，志工花了整個早上清除海灘上的垃圾。

en: Heavy snow rendered the mountain road too dangerous to use, so the bus had to turn back.
zh: 大雪讓山路危險到無法通行，所以公車只好掉頭。

en: Instead of buying a new bike, we paid a small rental fee and rode one around the lake.
zh: 我們沒有買新腳踏車，而是付了一筆小額租金，租了一輛環湖騎。

en: I promised to repay my sister the money she lent me as soon as I got my allowance.
zh: 我答應姊姊，一拿到零用錢就還她借我的錢。

en: In our world history class, we learned that the early Roman republicans opposed rule by a king.
zh: 在世界史課上，我們學到早期的羅馬共和主義者反對由國王統治。

en: Many people say that Mia bears a strong resemblance to her mother, especially when she smiles.
zh: 很多人說 Mia 和她媽媽長得非常像，尤其是她笑的時候。

en: After months without rain, the water level in the reservoir dropped to a record low.
zh: 幾個月沒下雨之後，水庫的水位降到了歷史新低。

en: My grandparents changed their residence from the city to a quiet village near the sea.
zh: 我的祖父母把住所從城市搬到靠海的一個寧靜村莊。

en: Local residents worked together to clean up the park after the summer music festival.
zh: 夏季音樂節結束後，當地居民一起合作清理公園。

en: Trucks are not allowed to drive through this residential area late at night.
zh: 深夜時，卡車不准行駛穿越這個住宅區。

en: Kenting is a popular beach resort in southern Taiwan that attracts many visitors every summer.
zh: 墾丁是台灣南部熱門的海灘度假勝地，每年夏天都吸引許多遊客。

en: More than half of the respondents to the survey said they sleep less than seven hours a night.
zh: 超過一半的受訪者在調查中表示，他們每晚睡不到七小時。

en: After a short break for lunch, the meeting resumed at two in the afternoon.
zh: 短暫的午餐休息之後，會議在下午兩點恢復進行。

en: My cousin found a part-time job in retail, selling clothes at a shop in the mall.
zh: 我表姊找到一份零售業的兼職工作，在購物中心的一家店賣衣服。

en: Most of the museum's revenue comes from ticket sales and its popular gift shop.
zh: 這間博物館的收入大部分來自門票銷售和它很受歡迎的禮品店。

en: If you reverse the order of the numbers, the answer to the math problem will be different.
zh: 如果你把數字的順序反過來，這道數學題的答案就會不一樣。

en: Good speakers use rhetoric to make their ideas sound clear, strong, and easy to remember.
zh: 優秀的演說者運用修辭，讓他們的想法聽起來清楚、有力又好記。

en: My brother broke a rib when he fell off his bike and couldn't play basketball for a month.
zh: 我哥哥騎腳踏車摔倒，斷了一根肋骨，所以一個月都不能打籃球。

en: We hiked along the ridge of the mountain and enjoyed a wide view of the valley below.
zh: 我們沿著山脊健行，欣賞下方山谷的遼闊景色。

en: Wearing a winter coat to the beach in July would look ridiculous to most people.
zh: 七月穿冬季大衣去海邊，在大多數人眼裡看起來會很荒謬。

en: At the history museum, we saw an old rifle that a soldier carried over a hundred years ago.
zh: 在歷史博物館裡，我們看到一把士兵在一百多年前使用過的舊步槍。

en: Some students feel that the school's rigid rules leave no room for creativity or personal style.
zh: 有些學生覺得學校嚴格的規定沒有留給創意或個人風格任何空間。

en: Be careful when you drink from that cup, because its rim is chipped.
zh: 用那個杯子喝水時要小心，因為杯口邊緣有缺角。

en: In history class, we read news reports about a riot that broke out after food prices suddenly rose.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們讀到關於食物價格突然上漲後爆發暴動的新聞報導。

en: Amy accidentally ripped her new jeans when she climbed over the fence behind the school.
zh: Amy 翻過學校後面的圍牆時，不小心把新牛仔褲撕破了。

en: Swimming alone in the sea at night is very risky, even for people who swim well.
zh: 晚上獨自在海裡游泳非常危險，即使是很會游泳的人也一樣。

en: Every morning, my grandmother follows the same ritual of making tea and reading the newspaper.
zh: 每天早上，我奶奶都遵循同樣的習慣儀式：泡茶和看報紙。

en: Our school's long-time rival, the high school next door, beats us in soccer almost every year.
zh: 我們學校的長期對手——隔壁那所高中——幾乎每年都在足球賽上打敗我們。

en: Grandpa took me to the lake and taught me how to use a fishing rod.
zh: 爺爺帶我到湖邊，教我怎麼用釣竿。

en: For many people, this ancient tree is a sacred place where they pray for good health.
zh: 對許多人來說，這棵古樹是他們祈求健康的神聖地方。

en: Before riding the horse, the farmer checked that the saddle was tied tightly to its back.
zh: 騎馬前，農夫檢查了馬鞍是否緊緊綁在馬背上。

en: My mom is a saint; she never gets angry, even when my little brother breaks things.
zh: 我媽媽簡直是聖人；即使弟弟把東西弄壞，她也從不生氣。

en: Every year, salmon swim back up the river to lay their eggs where they were born.
zh: 每年鮭魚都會逆流而上，回到牠們出生的地方產卵。

en: Lisa went to a hair salon to get her hair cut before the school dance.
zh: Lisa 在學校舞會前去美髮院剪頭髮。

en: On hot summer days, I prefer wearing sandals instead of shoes because my feet stay cool.
zh: 炎熱的夏天，我比較喜歡穿涼鞋而不是鞋子，因為腳可以保持涼爽。

en: Before reading an article carefully, I usually scan it quickly to find the main idea.
zh: 在仔細閱讀一篇文章之前，我通常會先快速瀏覽，找出主旨。

en: A cheating scandal at the local high school became the top story on the evening news.
zh: 當地一所高中的作弊醜聞成了晚間新聞的頭條。

en: Mia still has a small scar on her knee from falling off her bike as a child.
zh: Mia 的膝蓋上還留著一道小疤痕，是小時候騎腳踏車摔倒留下的。

en: In the worst-case scenario, heavy rain could close the mountain roads and cancel our school trip.
zh: 在最壞的情況下，大雨可能會使山路封閉，讓我們的校外教學取消。

en: As soon as Lisa opened the window, the sweet scent of roses from the garden filled her room.
zh: Lisa 一打開窗戶，花園裡玫瑰的甜美香氣就充滿了她的房間。

en: The city has started a new scheme to encourage people to recycle plastic bottles and cans.
zh: 市政府推出了一項新計畫，鼓勵民眾回收塑膠瓶和鋁罐。

en: Our teacher said the scope of our project was too wide and asked us to narrow it down.
zh: 老師說我們專題的範圍太廣，要我們把範圍縮小。

en: Hundreds of fans scrambled for the few remaining concert tickets as soon as they went on sale.
zh: 演唱會剩下的少數門票一開賣，數百名歌迷就搶成一團。

en: Lisa wrote her new friend's phone number on a scrap of paper but later could not find it.
zh: Lisa 把新朋友的電話號碼寫在一張碎紙片上，後來卻找不到了。

en: The drama club spent two weeks writing the script for their play about life in old Taipei.
zh: 戲劇社花了兩週，為他們描寫舊時台北生活的戲劇撰寫劇本。

en: Many young people in Taiwan hope to find jobs in the technology sector after college.
zh: 台灣許多年輕人希望大學畢業後能在科技業找到工作。

en: Before the class discussion, our teacher played a short segment of a film about ocean pollution.
zh: 在課堂討論前，老師播放了一段關於海洋污染的影片片段。

en: Professor Lin will give a seminar on healthy sleep habits for students next Thursday afternoon.
zh: 林教授下週四下午將為學生舉辦一場關於健康睡眠習慣的研討會。

en: In history class, we read a speech that an American senator gave about protecting national parks.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們讀了一篇美國參議員談保護國家公園的演講稿。

en: After sitting on her legs for an hour, Amy felt a strange sensation in her feet.
zh: 跪坐了一個小時之後，Amy 的腳有一種奇怪的感覺。

en: Some people have a high sensitivity to bright light and need dark glasses even on cloudy days.
zh: 有些人對強光非常敏感，即使在陰天也需要戴墨鏡。

en: Each light in our school hall has a sensor that turns it on when someone walks by.
zh: 我們學校走廊的每盞燈都裝有感應器，有人經過時就會自動亮起。

en: Public sentiment turned against the plan after people learned it would destroy part of the forest.
zh: 民眾得知這項計畫會破壞部分森林後，輿論便轉而反對。

en: She became sentimental and cried a little when she looked at her old photos from elementary school.
zh: 看著國小時期的舊照片，她變得多愁善感，還哭了一下。

en: Students must put the pictures in the correct sequence to show how a butterfly grows.
zh: 學生必須把圖片按正確的順序排好，以呈現蝴蝶的成長過程。

en: Over the weekend, Lisa watched every episode of a popular Korean drama series on her phone.
zh: 週末時，Lisa 用手機把一部熱門韓劇系列的每一集都看完了。

en: So many students checked their exam scores at once that the school's server stopped working.
zh: 太多學生同時查詢考試成績，導致學校的伺服器當機了。

en: After school, Amy joins a one-hour study session with her classmates in the library.
zh: 放學後，Amy 會和同學在圖書館一起讀書一小時。

en: The setting of the novel is a small fishing village in eastern Taiwan in the 1960s.
zh: 這本小說的背景是1960年代台灣東部的一個小漁村。

en: The company's shareholders were pleased when its profits rose by 20 percent last year.
zh: 公司去年利潤成長了百分之二十，股東們都很滿意。

en: When the glass fell from the kitchen table, it shattered into tiny pieces on the hard floor.
zh: 玻璃杯從餐桌上掉下來，在堅硬的地板上摔得粉碎。

en: Every spring, our dog sheds so much hair that we have to clean the sofa every day.
zh: 每年春天，我們家的狗都掉很多毛，我們每天都得清理沙發。

en: Ken finished the long race through sheer determination, even though his legs hurt badly.
zh: 雖然腿痛得厲害，Ken 還是全憑決心跑完了這場長距離賽跑。

en: In the old Western movie, the town sheriff worked hard to keep the peace and protect the people.
zh: 在那部老西部片中，鎮上的警長努力維持治安、保護居民。

en: Wearing a hat can help shield your face and eyes from the strong summer sun.
zh: 戴帽子可以幫助保護你的臉和眼睛，不受夏天強烈陽光的傷害。

en: Standing at the bus stop in the cold wind, Lisa began to shiver without a warm coat.
zh: 沒穿保暖外套的 Lisa 站在寒風中的公車站，開始發抖。

en: A water shortage in southern Taiwan forced some factories to cut back their production this spring.
zh: 台灣南部缺水，迫使部分工廠今年春天減產。

en: People shoved each other to get onto the crowded train during the morning rush hour.
zh: 早上尖峰時段，人們互相推擠，想擠上擁擠的列車。

en: When I asked Ben where he had put the keys, he just shrugged and said nothing.
zh: 我問 Ben 他把鑰匙放在哪裡，他只是聳聳肩，什麼也沒說。

en: A free shuttle bus takes visitors from the train station to the flower festival every half hour.
zh: 免費接駁車每半小時載送遊客從火車站前往花卉節。

en: Amy has three siblings, so she rarely gets the bathroom to herself in the morning.
zh: Amy 有三個兄弟姊妹，所以早上她很少能獨自使用浴室。

en: In history class, we learned how the city survived a long siege with very little food.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到這座城市如何在糧食極少的情況下撐過長期的圍城。

en: This museum displays the complete skeleton of a dinosaur that lived millions of years ago.
zh: 這間博物館展示了一副數百萬年前恐龍的完整骨骼。

en: Wearing a helmet protects your skull if you fall off your bike or scooter.
zh: 戴安全帽可以在你從腳踏車或機車上摔下來時保護頭骨。

en: Angry at her brother, Mia ran upstairs and slammed her bedroom door behind her.
zh: Mia 對哥哥很生氣，跑上樓後用力甩上了房門。

en: Kevin slapped at the mosquito on his arm, but it flew away just in time.
zh: Kevin 拍打手臂上的蚊子，但牠及時飛走了。

en: In history class, we read about people who worked to end slavery in the United States.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們讀到一些努力在美國終結奴隸制度的人。

en: Please put a coin in the slot, and the machine will give you a cold drink.
zh: 請把硬幣投入投幣孔，機器就會給你一瓶冰涼的飲料。

en: The ball flew through the air and smashed the classroom window into pieces.
zh: 球飛過空中，把教室的窗戶砸得粉碎。

en: Thick smog covered the city for days, so many people wore masks when they went outside.
zh: 濃厚的霧霾籠罩城市好幾天，所以許多人外出時都戴著口罩。

en: A monkey snatched the sandwich from Lisa's hand and quickly ran up a tree.
zh: 一隻猴子從 Lisa 手中搶走三明治，迅速爬上了樹。

en: Amy tried to sneak into the house quietly after coming home later than she had promised.
zh: Amy 比答應的時間晚回家，試著悄悄溜進屋裡。

en: Our dog sniffed the bag carefully before deciding that the food inside was safe to eat.
zh: 我們的狗仔細嗅了嗅袋子，才確定裡面的食物可以吃。

en: Soak the beans in water overnight so that they become soft and easier to cook.
zh: 把豆子泡在水裡一整晚，讓它們變軟、更容易煮。

en: Prices of vegetables soared after the typhoon destroyed many farms in central Taiwan.
zh: 颱風摧毀了台灣中部許多農田後，蔬菜價格暴漲。

en: The little girl sobbed quietly in the corner when she could not find her mother at the market.
zh: 小女孩在市場裡找不到媽媽，在角落裡低聲啜泣。

en: After the excitement of winning, the coach gave the team a sober reminder about the next game.
zh: 贏球的興奮過後，教練冷靜而嚴肅地提醒球隊注意下一場比賽。

en: Leave the butter on the table for an hour to soften it before you make the cookies.
zh: 做餅乾之前，先把奶油放在桌上一小時讓它變軟。

en: Lisa was the sole student in her class who got a perfect score on the math test.
zh: Lisa 是班上唯一在數學考試中拿到滿分的學生。

en: Amy was nervous before her piano solo at the school concert, but she played beautifully.
zh: Amy 在學校音樂會鋼琴獨奏前很緊張，但她彈得非常好。

en: Modern phones have sophisticated cameras that can take clear photos even in very dark places.
zh: 現代手機配備精密的相機，即使在很暗的地方也能拍出清晰的照片。

en: As a sophomore, Mia has more homework than last year, but she enjoys her new classes.
zh: 升上二年級的 Mia 作業比去年多，但她很喜歡新的課程。

en: Lisa bought a small key chain as a souvenir of her trip to Japan.
zh: Lisa 買了一個小鑰匙圈，當作日本之旅的紀念品。

en: After many years, the small island nation finally gained full sovereignty over its own land and sea.
zh: 經過多年，這個小島國終於取得了對自己領土與海域的完整主權。

en: Farmers usually sow rice seeds in spring and harvest the crop in early summer.
zh: 農夫通常在春天播下稻種，並在初夏收成。

en: Our new classroom is bright and spacious, with enough room for everyone to work in groups.
zh: 我們的新教室明亮又寬敞，有足夠的空間讓大家分組活動。

en: Her eyes sparkled with excitement when she opened the letter from her dream university.
zh: 她打開夢想大學寄來的信時，眼中閃爍著興奮的光芒。

en: Our family doctor sent Grandpa to a heart specialist for more tests last week.
zh: 我們的家庭醫師上週把爺爺轉介給心臟科專家做進一步檢查。

en: Dr. Chen specializes in sleep problems and has helped many teenagers who cannot sleep well.
zh: 陳醫師專攻睡眠問題，已經幫助過許多睡不好的青少年。

en: Beef noodle soup is the specialty of this small restaurant near the train station.
zh: 牛肉麵是火車站附近這家小餐館的招牌料理。

en: Our teacher did not specify how long the essay should be, so we asked her after class.
zh: 老師沒有具體說明作文要寫多長，所以我們下課後去問她。

en: Students looked at a leaf specimen under the microscope to study its tiny cells.
zh: 學生在顯微鏡下觀察葉子標本，研究它細小的細胞。

en: From the top of the mountain, we enjoyed a spectacular view of the sun rising over the clouds.
zh: 我們在山頂上欣賞到太陽從雲海升起的壯觀景色。

en: Thousands of spectators cheered loudly as the runners crossed the finish line.
zh: 跑者衝過終點線時，數千名觀眾大聲歡呼。

en: A rainbow shows all the colors of the spectrum, with red on the outside and purple inside.
zh: 彩虹呈現出光譜的所有顏色，外圈是紅色，內圈是紫色。

en: Scientists speculate that the ancient city was abandoned because of a long period of dry weather.
zh: 科學家推測，這座古城是因為長期乾旱而被廢棄的。

en: Our planet is not a perfect sphere, since it is slightly wider around the middle.
zh: 我們的星球並不是完美的球體，因為它的中間部分稍微寬一些。

en: Lisa loves spicy food and adds extra hot sauce to almost everything she eats.
zh: Lisa 很愛吃辣，幾乎吃什麼都會多加辣醬。

en: Sitting with your back straight helps protect your spine during long hours of study.
zh: 長時間讀書時保持背部挺直，有助於保護你的脊椎。

en: Use a soft sponge and warm water to clean the table instead of a rough cloth.
zh: 用柔軟的海綿和溫水擦桌子，不要用粗糙的布。

en: A local bookstore agreed to sponsor our school's reading contest by providing prizes for the top students.
zh: 當地一家書店同意贊助我們學校的閱讀比賽，提供獎品給表現最好的學生。

en: The art club received sponsorship from a local bakery to help pay for its spring show.
zh: 美術社獲得當地一家麵包店的贊助，用來支付春季展覽的部分費用。

en: Employees and their spouses are welcome to join the company's annual trip to Hualien.
zh: 員工及其配偶都歡迎參加公司一年一度的花蓮旅遊。

en: A rescue squad arrived quickly and helped everyone get out of the old building safely.
zh: 一支救援小隊迅速抵達，協助所有人安全離開那棟舊大樓。

en: Be careful not to squash the tomatoes by putting the heavy bag of rice on top.
zh: 小心別把那袋很重的米壓在上面，把番茄壓扁了。

en: Our coach asked us to squat down and hold the position for thirty seconds to build leg strength.
zh: 教練要我們蹲下並維持這個姿勢三十秒，以鍛鍊腿部力量。

en: Regular meals and enough sleep give young children a sense of stability in daily life.
zh: 規律的三餐和充足的睡眠，讓幼童在日常生活中有穩定感。

en: A tall stack of books sat on Amy's desk the week before final exams.
zh: 期末考前一週，Amy 的桌上堆著高高一疊書。

en: Mia tried hard to remove the coffee stain from her white shirt, but it would not come out.
zh: Mia 努力想去除白襯衫上的咖啡漬，但怎麼也洗不掉。

en: With so much at stake, the team practiced every day before the final game.
zh: 由於事關重大，球隊在決賽前每天都練習。

en: We bought fried chicken and bubble tea from a food stall at the night market.
zh: 我們在夜市的小吃攤買了炸雞和珍珠奶茶。

en: The principal took a firm stance against cheating and made new rules for all exams.
zh: 校長對作弊採取堅定的立場，並為所有考試訂立了新規定。

en: A loud noise from the kitchen startled the cat, and it jumped off the sofa.
zh: 廚房傳來的一聲巨響把貓嚇了一跳，牠從沙發上跳了下來。

en: Statistical data shows that teenagers who sleep less than six hours are more likely to feel stressed.
zh: 統計資料顯示，睡眠少於六小時的青少年比較容易感到壓力。

en: Dad steered the car carefully along the narrow mountain road in the heavy fog.
zh: 爸爸在濃霧中小心地把車開在狹窄的山路上。

en: It is a stereotype that girls are not good at science; many top scientists are women.
zh: 「女生不擅長科學」是一種刻板印象，許多頂尖科學家都是女性。

en: On cold winter nights, Grandma makes a hot beef stew with carrots and potatoes.
zh: 寒冷的冬夜裡，奶奶會煮一鍋熱騰騰的紅蘿蔔馬鈴薯燉牛肉。

en: Reading a wide range of books can stimulate children's imagination and curiosity.
zh: 廣泛閱讀各類書籍能激發孩子的想像力和好奇心。

en: In the experiment, the plants grew toward the light, which acted as a stimulus.
zh: 在實驗中，植物朝著光生長，而光就是一種刺激。

en: The trash can in the kitchen began to stink after we forgot to empty it for a week.
zh: 我們忘了倒廚房的垃圾桶一整個星期，它開始發臭了。

en: The shop assistant said that size was out of stock but more would arrive next week.
zh: 店員說那個尺寸目前缺貨，但下週會有新貨到。

en: We keep our winter clothes in storage boxes under the bed during the summer.
zh: 夏天時，我們把冬天的衣服收在床底下的收納箱裡。

en: Before the exam, our teacher asked us to straighten the desks into neat rows.
zh: 考試前，老師要我們把桌子排直，排成整齊的一行行。

en: The instructions were straightforward, so we set up the tent in less than ten minutes.
zh: 說明簡單明瞭，所以我們不到十分鐘就把帳篷搭好了。

en: Looking at a screen for hours puts a lot of strain on your eyes.
zh: 長時間盯著螢幕會對眼睛造成很大的負擔。

en: Heavy snow stranded hundreds of travelers at the airport for two days.
zh: 大雪讓數百名旅客受困機場兩天。

en: The strap of Mia's school bag broke, so she had to carry it in her arms all day.
zh: Mia 書包的背帶斷了，所以她整天只好把書包抱在手上。

en: The new train station was built in a strategic location close to schools, hospitals, and shops.
zh: 新火車站建在靠近學校、醫院和商店的策略性位置。

en: There is a striking difference between the city's air quality in summer and in winter.
zh: 這座城市夏季和冬季的空氣品質有顯著的差異。

en: After the earthquake, engineers checked the school buildings for any structural damage.
zh: 地震過後，工程師檢查學校建築是否有任何結構上的損壞。

en: Lisa stumbled over a rock on the dark mountain path but caught herself before falling.
zh: Lisa 在黑暗的山路上被石頭絆了一下，但在跌倒前穩住了身子。

en: We need a sturdy table that can hold the heavy fish tank without shaking.
zh: 我們需要一張堅固的桌子，能撐住沉重的魚缸而不搖晃。

en: All students must submit their science reports online before midnight on Friday.
zh: 所有學生都必須在星期五午夜前上網繳交科學報告。

en: The first test was difficult, but Amy did much better on the subsequent ones.
zh: 第一次考試很難，但 Amy 在之後的幾次考試中表現好多了。

en: The government offers a subsidy to families who buy electric scooters instead of gas ones.
zh: 政府提供補助給購買電動機車、而非燃油機車的家庭。

en: Walking for thirty minutes a day can make a substantial difference to your body and mind.
zh: 每天走路三十分鐘，能讓你的身心有顯著的改善。

en: Our English teacher was sick today, so a substitute teacher taught our class.
zh: 我們的英文老師今天生病了，所以由代課老師來上我們班的課。

en: There is a subtle difference between the two colors, so most people cannot tell them apart.
zh: 這兩種顏色之間有微妙的差異，所以大多數人分辨不出來。

en: Many families move from the city center to suburban areas, where houses are bigger and cheaper.
zh: 許多家庭從市中心搬到郊區，那裡的房子比較大也比較便宜。

en: When the old principal retired, the school chose Ms. Wang as her successor.
zh: 老校長退休後，學校選出王老師作為她的繼任者。

en: Our family stayed in a hotel suite with two bedrooms and a small kitchen.
zh: 我們一家人住在一間有兩個臥室和小廚房的飯店套房。

en: Everyone agreed that the young singer gave a superb performance at last night's concert.
zh: 大家一致認為那位年輕歌手在昨晚的演唱會上表現極為出色。

en: An old superstition says that breaking a mirror brings seven years of bad luck.
zh: 一個古老的迷信說，打破鏡子會帶來七年的厄運。

en: Two teachers will supervise the students during the science experiment in the lab.
zh: 兩位老師會在實驗室裡監督學生進行科學實驗。

en: Young children should not swim without adult supervision, even in a shallow pool.
zh: 幼童即使在淺水池裡，也不應在沒有大人監督的情況下游泳。

en: Lisa asked her supervisor at the coffee shop if she could leave early to study for her exam.
zh: Lisa 問咖啡店的主管，她能不能提早下班去準備考試。

en: This old temple is supposedly the oldest in the city, but no one knows for sure.
zh: 據說這座老廟是城裡最古老的，但沒有人能確定。

en: Winning the gold medal was the supreme moment of her long career as an athlete.
zh: 贏得金牌是她漫長運動生涯中最巔峰的時刻。

en: The farmers had a surplus of apples this year, so they gave some to local schools.
zh: 農民今年的蘋果過剩，所以把一些送給了當地的學校。

en: The store put in surveillance cameras after several items went missing last month.
zh: 上個月有幾件商品不見後，這家店裝設了監視攝影機。

en: All classes were suspended for two days because of the strong typhoon in northern Taiwan.
zh: 由於強烈颱風侵襲北台灣，所有課程暫停兩天。

en: Eating a healthy breakfast helps sustain your energy throughout the morning at school.
zh: 吃一頓健康的早餐，有助於在學校的整個上午維持你的精力。

en: Our town is trying to develop sustainable tourism that protects the forests and the local culture.
zh: 我們的小鎮正努力發展能保護森林和在地文化的永續觀光。

en: Amy and Lisa swapped seats so that Amy could sit closer to the window.
zh: Amy 和 Lisa 交換座位，讓 Amy 可以坐得離窗戶近一點。

en: In Chinese culture, the color red is symbolic of good luck and joy.
zh: 在中華文化中，紅色象徵好運和喜悅。

en: Common symptoms of the flu include fever, sore throat, and feeling very tired.
zh: 流感的常見症狀包括發燒、喉嚨痛和非常疲倦。

en: Doctors say that sitting at a computer for too long can cause dry eye syndrome.
zh: 醫生說，長時間坐在電腦前可能導致乾眼症。

en: We need to work together to tackle the problem of plastic waste at our school.
zh: 我們需要一起合作，處理學校的塑膠垃圾問題。

en: Our coach changed tactics in the second half, and we finally scored two goals.
zh: 教練在下半場改變策略，我們終於進了兩球。

en: Her long hair got tangled in the wind, so she spent ten minutes brushing it.
zh: 她的長髮被風吹得纏成一團，所以她花了十分鐘才梳開。

en: On our way home, the smell of fried chicken tempted us to stop at the night market.
zh: 回家路上，炸雞的香味誘惑我們在夜市停下腳步。

en: It is hard to resist the temptation to check your phone while doing homework.
zh: 寫作業時，很難抗拒想看手機的誘惑。

en: Our flight to Tokyo leaves from Terminal 2, so we need to take the airport train.
zh: 我們飛往東京的班機從第二航廈出發，所以我們得搭機場捷運。

en: Thunder and lightning terrify my little sister, so she hides under her blanket during storms.
zh: 打雷和閃電讓我妹妹非常害怕，所以暴風雨時她會躲在被子裡。

en: A woman who saw the car accident agreed to testify in court about what happened.
zh: 一位目擊車禍的女士同意出庭作證，說明事情的經過。

en: This cake has a light, soft texture that seems to melt in your mouth.
zh: 這個蛋糕口感輕盈鬆軟，彷彿入口即化。

en: The police are looking into the theft of several bikes from the school parking lot.
zh: 警方正在調查學校停車場數輛腳踏車遭竊的案件。

en: Her older brother studies theology at college because he wants to understand different religions.
zh: 她哥哥在大學念神學，因為他想了解不同的宗教。

en: The idea is interesting, but it is only theoretical and has never been tested in real life.
zh: 這個想法很有趣，但只是理論上的，從未在現實生活中測試過。

en: After her knee injury, Lisa saw a physical therapist twice a week to help her walk normally again.
zh: 膝蓋受傷後，Lisa 每週去看兩次物理治療師，幫助她恢復正常行走。

en: Music therapy can help reduce stress and worry for patients in the hospital.
zh: 音樂治療可以幫助住院病人減輕壓力與焦慮。

en: Lisa started riding her bike to school, thereby saving money and getting more exercise.
zh: Lisa 開始騎腳踏車上學，因此既省了錢，也多了運動。

en: My cousin spent a whole year writing her master's thesis on ocean pollution.
zh: 我表姊花了一整年撰寫關於海洋污染的碩士論文。

en: Running up the stairs every day made the muscles in Ken's thighs much stronger.
zh: 每天跑樓梯讓 Ken 大腿的肌肉變得強壯許多。

en: Some people have a low pain threshold and feel even small cuts very strongly.
zh: 有些人的痛覺門檻很低，即使是小傷口也會覺得很痛。

en: Seeing her favorite singer on stage gave Mia a thrill that she would never forget.
zh: 看到最喜歡的歌手站上舞台，帶給 Mia 永生難忘的興奮感。

en: Ben loves reading thrillers because he can never guess what will happen next.
zh: Ben 很愛看驚悚小說，因為他永遠猜不到接下來會發生什麼事。

en: These plants thrive in warm, wet places and grow quickly during the rainy season.
zh: 這些植物在溫暖潮濕的地方生長茂盛，雨季時長得特別快。

en: The young prince was only ten years old when he came to the throne after his father's death.
zh: 年幼的王子在父親過世後登上王位時，年僅十歲。

en: The main thrust of the article is that teenagers need more sleep than adults.
zh: 這篇文章的主旨是青少年比成年人需要更多睡眠。

en: Please tick the box next to the answer that you think is correct.
zh: 請在你認為正確的答案旁邊的方框內打勾。

en: White tiles cover the bathroom floor, so it becomes slippery when it gets wet.
zh: 浴室地板鋪滿白色磁磚，所以一弄濕就會變得很滑。

en: Grandma keeps the cookies she bakes in a round tin on the kitchen shelf.
zh: 奶奶把她烤的餅乾裝在廚房架上的一個圓形鐵罐裡。

en: Drivers must pay a toll to use the new highway between the two cities.
zh: 駕駛人必須支付通行費，才能使用連接兩座城市的新高速公路。

en: At the opening of the sports meet, a famous runner carried the torch around the field.
zh: 在運動會開幕時，一位知名跑者手持火炬繞行操場。

en: For weeks, Amy was tormented by the fear that she had failed the important exam.
zh: 好幾個星期，Amy 都被「自己可能考砸了那場重要考試」的恐懼折磨著。

en: Our school's basketball team won first place in the city tournament last weekend.
zh: 我們學校的籃球隊上週末在市級錦標賽中奪得冠軍。

en: Some cleaning products give off toxic gases, so always open a window when using them.
zh: 有些清潔用品會釋放有毒氣體，所以使用時一定要打開窗戶。

en: Honesty and a kind heart are the traits that Lisa values most in her friends.
zh: 誠實和善良的心，是 Lisa 最看重的朋友特質。

en: In the novel, the king discovers that his closest adviser is actually a traitor.
zh: 在這本小說中，國王發現他最親近的顧問其實是個叛徒。

en: These days, people can complete most bank transactions on their phones without waiting in line.
zh: 現在人們用手機就能完成大部分的銀行交易，不必排隊等候。

en: The old factory went through a complete transformation and is now a popular art center.
zh: 那座老工廠經歷了徹底的轉變，現在成了熱門的藝術中心。

en: Many people in Taipei rely on public transit, such as the MRT and buses, to get to work.
zh: 台北許多人仰賴大眾運輸，例如捷運和公車來通勤上班。

en: The transition from junior high to senior high school can be difficult for many students.
zh: 從國中到高中的過渡期，對許多學生來說可能很不容易。

en: Wearing a mask can reduce the transmission of the virus in crowded places.
zh: 戴口罩可以減少病毒在擁擠場所的傳播。

en: Plastic bags look transparent in water, so sea turtles sometimes eat them by mistake.
zh: 塑膠袋在水中看起來是透明的，所以海龜有時會誤食。

en: Some children who survive an earthquake need help dealing with the trauma for years afterward.
zh: 有些在地震中倖存的孩子，多年後仍需要協助來面對心理創傷。

en: After years of talks, the two countries finally signed a treaty to protect the ocean.
zh: 經過多年談判，兩國終於簽署了一項保護海洋的條約。

en: Fans held a special concert as a tribute to the famous singer who had died the year before.
zh: 歌迷舉辦了一場特別的音樂會，向前一年過世的知名歌手致敬。

en: Stress and lack of sleep are two common things that can trigger headaches in teenagers.
zh: 壓力和睡眠不足是兩個常見會引發青少年頭痛的因素。

en: Dad trims the bushes in our front yard every few weeks to keep them neat.
zh: 爸爸每隔幾週就會修剪前院的灌木叢，讓它們保持整齊。

en: The number of visitors to the small town tripled after it appeared in a popular movie.
zh: 那個小鎮在一部熱門電影中出現後，遊客人數增加為原來的三倍。

en: Don't waste time arguing about trivial things, such as who gets to sit by the window.
zh: 別把時間浪費在爭論瑣碎的事情上，例如誰可以坐靠窗的位置。

en: The captain proudly lifted the trophy as the whole team celebrated their victory.
zh: 隊長驕傲地舉起獎盃，全隊一起慶祝勝利。

en: Tuition at private universities in Taiwan is usually much higher than at public ones.
zh: 台灣私立大學的學費通常比公立大學高很多。

en: Doctors found a small tumor in his brain, but luckily it was not dangerous.
zh: 醫生在他的腦部發現一顆小腫瘤，但幸運的是它並不危險。

en: Lisa made tuna sandwiches for the picnic, and everyone asked her for the recipe.
zh: Lisa 為野餐做了鮪魚三明治，大家都向她要食譜。

en: Our ultimate goal is to clean up the river so that fish and birds can return to it.
zh: 我們的最終目標是清理河川，讓魚和鳥能夠回來。

en: Reporters uncovered the truth that the factory had been secretly pouring waste into the river.
zh: 記者揭露了那家工廠一直偷偷把廢水倒進河裡的真相。

en: Grandpa will undergo heart surgery next month, so the whole family is a little worried.
zh: 爺爺下個月要接受心臟手術，所以全家人都有點擔心。

en: As an undergraduate, Amy's sister studied biology and spent her summers working at a nature center.
zh: Amy 的姊姊在大學時期主修生物，暑假都在自然中心工作。

en: Please underline the key words in each paragraph before you answer the questions.
zh: 回答問題前，請在每一段的關鍵字下面畫底線。

en: Staying up late every night can undermine your memory and your ability to focus in class.
zh: 每晚熬夜會削弱你的記憶力和上課專心的能力。

en: Our class decided to undertake a project to plant 100 trees along the river near school.
zh: 我們班決定進行一項計畫，在學校附近的河邊種植一百棵樹。

en: If you make a mistake while typing, press these two keys to undo it.
zh: 打字時如果出錯，按下這兩個鍵就能取消。

en: Undoubtedly, the Internet has changed the way teenagers communicate with their friends.
zh: 毫無疑問，網路已經改變了青少年和朋友溝通的方式。

en: Unemployment among young people rose after many factories in the area closed down.
zh: 該地區許多工廠倒閉後，年輕人的失業率上升了。

en: As the story unfolds, we slowly learn the secret behind the old house.
zh: 隨著故事展開，我們漸漸得知那棟老房子背後的秘密。

en: Lisa forgot her password and could not unlock her new phone for almost an hour.
zh: Lisa 忘了密碼，將近一個小時都無法解鎖她的新手機。

en: Taipei experienced unprecedented heat this summer, with temperatures reaching 40 degrees for the first time.
zh: 台北今年夏天經歷了史無前例的高溫，氣溫首次達到四十度。

en: Remember to update the software on your computer regularly so that it runs smoothly and safely.
zh: 記得定期更新電腦裡的軟體，讓它運作得順暢又安全。

en: Ben saved money for months to upgrade his old computer before starting college.
zh: Ben 存了好幾個月的錢，在上大學前把他的舊電腦升級。

en: Water, gas, and electricity are utilities that every family pays for each month.
zh: 水、瓦斯和電是每個家庭每個月都要付費的公用事業。

en: Farmers in this village utilize rain stored in large tanks to water their crops in the dry season.
zh: 這個村子的農民在乾季時，利用儲存在大水槽裡的雨水灌溉農作物。

en: Every Saturday morning, Amy helps her mom vacuum the living room and clean the windows.
zh: 每個星期六早上，Amy 都會幫媽媽用吸塵器打掃客廳並擦窗戶。

en: His answer was so vague that none of us understood what he really meant.
zh: 他的回答太模糊了，我們沒有人明白他真正的意思。

en: Your student ID card is valid until the end of the school year.
zh: 你的學生證有效期限到這學年結束為止。

en: In this experiment, the amount of light is the only variable that we change.
zh: 在這個實驗中，光照量是我們唯一改變的變數。

en: There is a lot of variation in temperature between day and night in the desert.
zh: 沙漠中日夜之間的溫度變化很大。

en: The nurse looked for a vein in my arm before taking a blood sample.
zh: 護理師在抽血前，先找我手臂上的靜脈。

en: Street vendors sell hot sweet potatoes and fresh fruit near the entrance of the night market.
zh: 街頭攤販在夜市入口附近賣熱騰騰的烤地瓜和新鮮水果。

en: After college, Ben started a small business venture that sells used books online.
zh: 大學畢業後，Ben 創立了一個在網路上販售二手書的小事業。

en: Our school gym will be the venue for the singing contest next Friday afternoon.
zh: 我們學校的體育館將是下週五下午歌唱比賽的舉辦場地。

en: Our teacher gave each group verbal instructions instead of writing them on the board.
zh: 老師用口頭方式給每組指示，而不是寫在黑板上。

en: After two days of careful thought, the judge reached a verdict of not guilty.
zh: 經過兩天的審慎考慮，法官做出了無罪判決。

en: The movie is quite different from the original book version, which has a sadder ending.
zh: 這部電影和原著小說版本很不一樣，原著的結局比較悲傷。

en: Tonight's big game is Taiwan versus Japan, and the whole class plans to watch it together.
zh: 今晚的重要比賽是台灣對日本，全班打算一起觀看。

en: Two men slowly climbed up the almost vertical wall of the mountain with ropes.
zh: 兩名男子用繩索沿著幾乎垂直的山壁慢慢往上爬。

en: A war veteran visited our history class to share his memories of the past.
zh: 一位退伍老兵來到我們的歷史課，分享他過去的回憶。

en: You can send your homework to the teacher via email before Sunday night.
zh: 你可以在星期日晚上前透過電子郵件把作業寄給老師。

en: Scientists believe that solar power is a viable way to reduce air pollution.
zh: 科學家相信太陽能是減少空氣污染的一種可行方法。

en: Some students spread vicious rumors about a new classmate online, which hurt her deeply.
zh: 有些學生在網路上散播關於新同學的惡毒謠言，深深傷害了她。

en: Millions of viewers around the world watched the singing contest live on TV last night.
zh: 全世界數百萬名觀眾昨晚在電視上收看了這場歌唱比賽的現場直播。

en: Reading news from different sources helps you understand events from more than one viewpoint.
zh: 閱讀不同來源的新聞，能幫助你從多個觀點理解事件。

en: Grandma cleans the windows with a mix of warm water and white vinegar.
zh: 奶奶用溫水和白醋的混合液來擦窗戶。

en: On the museum's virtual tour, visitors can walk through ancient Rome using only a computer.
zh: 透過博物館的虛擬導覽，參觀者只要用電腦就能漫步古羅馬。

en: Taiwanese travelers do not need a visa to visit Japan for a short stay.
zh: 台灣旅客短期赴日本旅遊不需要簽證。

en: Lisa has been vocal about the need for more recycling bins at school.
zh: Lisa 一直大聲疾呼學校需要更多資源回收桶。

en: Scientists are watching the volcano closely because it has shown signs of activity recently.
zh: 科學家正密切監測這座火山，因為它最近出現了活動跡象。

en: Ken ate too much fried food at the party and vomited later that night.
zh: Ken 在派對上吃了太多油炸食物，當晚稍後就吐了。

en: Lisa won a voucher for a free meal at the new restaurant near her school.
zh: Lisa 贏得一張學校附近新餐廳的免費餐券。

en: After failing the test, Kevin vowed to study harder and spend less time playing games.
zh: 考試不及格後，Kevin 發誓要更用功讀書，少花點時間玩遊戲。

en: Young children and the elderly are more vulnerable to the flu during the winter months.
zh: 幼童和老年人在冬季比較容易感染流感。

en: This online shop keeps all its products in a huge warehouse outside the city.
zh: 這家網路商店把所有商品存放在市郊一座巨大的倉庫裡。

en: In the old legend, a brave warrior saved the village from a terrible dragon.
zh: 在古老的傳說中，一位勇敢的戰士從可怕的龍手中拯救了村莊。

en: Children should be wary of strangers who offer them free gifts on the street.
zh: 孩子應該提防在街上送他們免費禮物的陌生人。

en: Amy heard a weird noise coming from the empty classroom, so she went to check.
zh: Amy 聽到空教室裡傳來奇怪的聲音，於是過去查看。

en: Ben had no interest whatsoever in sports until he joined the school volleyball team.
zh: Ben 加入學校排球隊之前，對運動絲毫不感興趣。

en: The new library has elevators and wide doors so that people in wheelchairs can enter easily.
zh: 新圖書館設有電梯和寬敞的門，讓坐輪椅的人能輕鬆進出。

en: The owner put up posters asking for information about the whereabouts of her missing cat.
zh: 飼主張貼海報，請大家提供她走失貓咪下落的消息。

en: Lisa loves to read quietly at home, whereas her sister prefers to go out with friends.
zh: Lisa 喜歡在家安靜地看書，而她妹妹則比較喜歡和朋友出去。

en: The little boy kept whining about being hungry during the long drive to Grandma's house.
zh: 那個小男孩在前往奶奶家的漫長車程中，一直抱怨肚子餓。

en: Cell phone use is now widespread among elementary school students in Taiwan.
zh: 現在台灣的國小學生使用手機已經非常普遍。

en: For the school play, Amy wore a long white wig to look like an old queen.
zh: 為了學校的戲劇演出，Amy 戴了一頂長長的白色假髮扮成老皇后。

en: The travelers spent three days in the wilderness without seeing another person.
zh: 那些旅人在荒野中待了三天，都沒有看到其他人。

en: Building roads through the forest can harm the wildlife that lives there.
zh: 在森林裡開闢道路，可能會傷害住在那裡的野生動物。

en: Heavy rain hit the windshield so hard that Dad could hardly see the road ahead.
zh: 大雨猛烈地打在擋風玻璃上，讓爸爸幾乎看不清前方的路。

en: Without enough water during the hot summer, the flowers in our garden began to wither.
zh: 在炎熱的夏天缺乏足夠的水，我們花園裡的花開始枯萎了。

en: Our English teacher is so witty that her jokes make even a boring lesson fun.
zh: 我們的英文老師很機智，她的笑話讓無聊的課也變得有趣。

en: Lisa signed up for a weekend workshop to learn how to take better photos with her phone.
zh: Lisa 報名了一個週末工作坊，學習如何用手機拍出更好的照片。

en: Every year, thousands of people visit this temple to worship the goddess of the sea.
zh: 每年都有數千人到這座廟祭拜海上女神。

en: Helping at the animal shelter was a worthwhile experience that taught Amy a lot about responsibility.
zh: 在動物收容所幫忙是很值得的經驗，讓 Amy 學到很多關於責任的事。

en: Her years of helping poor children in the village are worthy of everyone's respect.
zh: 她多年來幫助村裡貧困孩子的付出，值得大家尊敬。

en: The rich businessman sailed his yacht around the island during the summer holidays.
zh: 那位富有的商人在暑假期間駕著他的遊艇環島航行。

en: With better farming methods, the fields now yield twice as much rice as before.
zh: 有了更好的耕作方法，這些田地現在的稻米產量是以前的兩倍。
